2.s: yuñjate mana ity āhavanīye juhoti | manasā vai prajāpatir yajñam atanuta tato vācā tataḥ karmaṇā | manasaivaitad yajamāno yajñaṃ vitatya tato vācā tataḥ karmaṇā karoti |
2.d: युञ्जते मन इत्य् आहवनीये जुहोति । मनसा वै प्रजापतिर् यज्ञम् अतनुत ततो वाचा ततः कर्मणा । मनसैवैतद् यजमानो यज्ञं वितत्य ततो वाचा ततः कर्मणा करोति ।
2.m: With "The brahmans harness, they harness the mind," he offers into the Āhavanīya fire. Prajāpati indeed extended the sacrifice through the mind; then through speech, then through action. Having extended the sacrifice through the mind alone, the sacrificer then performs it through speech, then through action. 1 With "At the impulse of the god Savitṛ," he takes the spades. Impelled by Savitṛ alone, he takes them with the deities. He takes four. Four indeed are the quarters; from the quarters the Pravargya is collected; from the quarters indeed he collects the Pravargya. They are made of wood; by means of trees indeed the Pravargya is collected; by means of trees indeed he collects the Pravargya. 2 With "Stand up, O Brahmaṇaspati," he stands up. Brahmaṇaspati is indeed Bṛhaspati; having become Bṛhaspati himself, he stands up. 3 With "May the bounteous Maruts come forward," [he goes]. The bounteous Maruts are indeed connected with the wilderness; in the wilderness the Pravargya is collected; in the wilderness he makes it belonging to the wilderness. 4 With "May Brahmaṇaspati go forth," he firmly steps forward. Brahmaṇaspati is indeed Bṛhaspati; having become Bṛhaspati himself, he firmly steps forward. 5 With "May the divine Sūnṛtā come," [he speaks]. The divine Sūnṛtā is indeed speech; through speech the Pravargya is collected; through speech alone he collects the Pravargya. 6 With "Unto the valiant hero, favorable to men, providing fivefold wealth," [he goes]. The hero favorable to men and providing fivefold wealth is indeed the sacrifice; he collects the sacrifice for the gods alone. 7 With "O divine Heaven and Earth, may you consent for me at the sacrificial ground," [he addresses them]. These two indeed were afraid of the Mahāvīra while it was being collected, thinking: "It will burn us up with its fiery energy." Bṛhaspati said to them: "It is a share for you two." Then they consented to it. 8 With "May I today prosper the head of Makha of the cosmic order," he collects [the earth]. He collects the head of the sacrifice alone. He brings [earth] three times, for the gods are threefold true. He surrounds [the pit] all around with the spades, to ward off the demons. When Prajāpati was desirous of creating offspring, his sacrificial fiery energy departed from him. It entered into this [earth].

2.s: devasya vas savituḥ prasava ity abhrīr ādatte | savitṛprasūta evainā devatābhir ādatte | catasra ādatte | catasro vai diśo | digbhyaḥ pravargyas sambhriyate | digbhya eva pravargyaṃ sambharati | vānaspatyā bhavanti | vanaspatibhir vai pravargyas sambhriyate | vanaspatibhir eva pravargyaṃ sambharaty |
2.d: देवस्य वस् सवितुः प्रसव इत्य् अभ्रीर् आदत्ते । सवितृप्रसूत एवैना देवताभिर् आदत्ते । चतस्र आदत्ते । चतस्रो वै दिशो । दिग्भ्यः प्रवर्ग्यस् सम्भ्रियते । दिग्भ्य एव प्रवर्ग्यं सम्भरति । वानस्पत्या भवन्ति । वनस्पतिभिर् वै प्रवर्ग्यस् सम्भ्रियते । वनस्पतिभिर् एव प्रवर्ग्यं सम्भरत्य् ।

2.s: uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspata ity uttiṣṭhati | bṛhaspatir vai brahmaṇaspatir | bṛhaspatir eva bhūtvottiṣṭhaty |
2.d: उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पत इत्य् उत्तिष्ठति । बृहस्पतिर् वै ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् । बृहस्पतिर् एव भूत्वोत्तिष्ठत्य् ।

2.s: upa prayantu marutas sudānava iti | sudānavo vai maruta āraṇyā | araṇye pravargyas sambhriyate | 'raṇya evāraṇyaṃ karoti |
2.d: उप प्रयन्तु मरुतस् सुदानव इति । सुदानवो वै मरुत आरण्या । अरण्ये प्रवर्ग्यस् सम्भ्रियते । ऽरण्य एवारण्यं करोति ।

2.s: praitu brahmaṇaspatir iti pratitiṣṭhati | bṛhaspatir vai brahmaṇaspatir | bṛhaspatir eva bhūtvā pratitiṣṭhaty |
2.d: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् इति प्रतितिष्ठति । बृहस्पतिर् वै ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् । बृहस्पतिर् एव भूत्वा प्रतितिष्ठत्य् ।

2.s: ā devy etu sūnṛteti | vāg vai devī sūnṛtā | vācā pravargyas sambhriyate | vācaiva pravargyaṃ sambharaty |
2.d: आ देव्य् एतु सूनृतेति । वाग् वै देवी सूनृता । वाचा प्रवर्ग्यस् सम्भ्रियते । वाचैव प्रवर्ग्यं सम्भरत्य् ।

2.s: aśchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasam iti | yajño vai vīro naryaḥ paṅktirādhā | devebhya eva yajñaṃ sambharati |
2.d: अश्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसम् इति । यज्ञो वै वीरो नर्यः पङ्क्तिराधा । देवेभ्य एव यज्ञं सम्भरति ।

2.s: devī dyāvāpṛthivī devayajane 'nu me maṃsāthām itīme vai mahāvīrāt sambhriyamāṇād abibhītām | tejasā nā uddhakṣyatīti | sa bṛhaspatir abravīd | yuvayor bhāgadheyam iti | tata enam anvamanyatām |
2.d: देवी द्यावापृथिवी देवयजने ऽनु मे मंसाथाम् इतीमे वै महावीरात् सम्भ्रियमाणाद् अबिभीताम् । तेजसा ना उद्धक्ष्यतीति । स बृहस्पतिर् अब्रवीद् । युवयोर् भागधेयम् इति । तत एनम् अन्वमन्यताम् ।

2.s: ṛtasya rdhyāsam adya makhasya śira iti sambharati | yajñasyaiva śiras sambharati | trir harati | triṣatyā hi devās | samantam abhrīḥ pariśrayati rakṣasām parāṇuttyai | prajāpater vai prajās sisṛkṣamāṇasya tasya tejo yajñiyam apākrāmat | tad imām prāviśat | tad varāho bhūtvānvavindad |
2.d: ऋतस्य र्ध्यासम् अद्य मखस्य शिर इति सम्भरति । यज्ञस्यैव शिरस् सम्भरति । त्रिर् हरति । त्रिषत्या हि देवास् । समन्तम् अभ्रीः परिश्रयति रक्षसाम् पराणुत्त्यै । प्रजापतेर् वै प्रजास् सिसृक्षमाणस्य तस्य तेजो यज्ञियम् अपाक्रामत् । तद् इमाम् प्राविशत् । तद् वराहो भूत्वान्वविन्दद् ।
2.m: Having become a boar, he found it. 9 With "You were [dug up] from the beginning," [he takes it]. That it is dug up by a boar means he collects the sacrificial fiery energy of this [earth] alone. 10 With "The divine ants are the firstborn of this existence," [he recites]. The ants are indeed the firstborn of this existence; they know where the sacrificial life of this [earth] is. In that he collects the earth of an anthill, he collects the sacrificial life of this [earth] alone. When Indra slew Vṛtra, his might and valor departed from him. It entered into the plants; they became the pūtīka plants. 11 With "You are the might of Indra," [he takes them]. In that he collects the pūtīka plants, he collects the might and valor of Indra alone. 12 With "You are the body of Prajāpati," they milk a she-goat. The she-goat is indeed this dear body of Prajāpati. In that they milk a she-goat, he collects the dear body of Prajāpati alone. 13 With "May the sweetening [herb] make you sweet," he pours the water on. He mixes this sweet [matter] with sweetness; it becomes sweet. 14 With "You are the head of Makha," he takes up the lump of clay. Makha is indeed the sacrifice; he makes the head of the sacrifice alone. 15 With "You two are in the step of the sacrifice," he presses down. He makes [them] in the step of the sacrifice alone. 16 With "You belong to the Gāyatrī," he puts on the first layer. The Gāyatrī is indeed priestly splendor, fiery energy; he places fiery energy and the priesthood in the sacrificer. 17 With "You belong to the Triṣṭubh," he puts on the second layer. The Triṣṭubh is indeed might and valor; he places might and valor in the sacrificer. 18 With "You belong to the Jagatī," he puts on the third layer. The Jagatī is indeed cattle; he places cattle in the sacrificer. 19 With "You are Makha," he makes it Makha itself. 20 With "You are the girdle of Makha," he makes the girdle. Makha is indeed the sacrifice; he makes it for the sacrifice alone. It is a span in measure; of such a size indeed is the face. Agni is the face of the gods; being equal in size to the face, it becomes a vessel at the top for the satisfaction of the deities. He is satisfied with offspring and cattle; the drinking of soma inclines toward him, who knows thus. 21 With "Bake in the heat of the sun," he places [it] in the heat.

2.s: ityaty agra āsīr iti | yad varāhavihatam bhavaty asyā eva tejo yajñiyaṃ sambharati |
2.d: इत्यत्य् अग्र आसीर् इति । यद् वराहविहतम् भवत्य् अस्या एव तेजो यज्ञियं सम्भरति ।

2.s: devīr vamriyo 'sya bhūtasya prathamajā iti | vamriyo vā asya bhūtasya prathamajās | tā vā etad vidur yatrāsyā jīvaṃ yajñiyaṃ | yad valmīkavāpanāṃ sambharaty asyā eva jīvaṃ yajñiyaṃ sambharatīndro vai yad vṛtram ahaṃs tasyaujo vīryam apākrāmat | tad oṣadhīḥ prāviśat | te pūtīkā abhavann |
2.d: देवीर् वम्रियो ऽस्य भूतस्य प्रथमजा इति । वम्रियो वा अस्य भूतस्य प्रथमजास् । ता वा एतद् विदुर् यत्रास्या जीवं यज्ञियं । यद् वल्मीकवापनां सम्भरत्य् अस्या एव जीवं यज्ञियं सम्भरतीन्द्रो वै यद् वृत्रम् अहंस् तस्यौजो वीर्यम् अपाक्रामत् । तद् ओषधीः प्राविशत् । ते पूतीका अभवन्न् ।

2.s: indrasyaujo 'sīti | yat pūtīkānāṃ sambharatīndrasyaivaujo vīryaṃ sambharati |
2.d: इन्द्रस्यौजो ऽसीति । यत् पूतीकानां सम्भरतीन्द्रस्यैवौजो वीर्यं सम्भरति ।

2.s: prajāpates tanūr asīty ajāṃ duhanti | prajāpater vā eṣā priyā tanūr yad ajā | yad ajāṃ duhanti prajāpater eva priyān tanvaṃ sambharati |
2.d: प्रजापतेस् तनूर् असीत्य् अजां दुहन्ति । प्रजापतेर् वा एषा प्रिया तनूर् यद् अजा । यद् अजां दुहन्ति प्रजापतेर् एव प्रियान् तन्वं सम्भरति ।

2.s: madhu tvā madhulā karotv ity apa upasṛjati | madhu vā etan madhunā saṃyauti | madhavyo bhavati |
2.d: मधु त्वा मधुला करोत्व् इत्य् अप उपसृजति । मधु वा एतन् मधुना संयौति । मधव्यो भवति ।

2.s: makhasya śiro 'sīti piṇḍam upādatte | yajño vai makho | yajñasyaiva śiraḥ karoti |
2.d: मखस्य शिरो ऽसीति पिण्डम् उपादत्ते । यज्ञो वै मखो । यज्ञस्यैव शिरः करोति ।

2.s: yajñasya pade stha ity avabādhate | yajñasyaiva pade karoti |
2.d: यज्ञस्य पदे स्थ इत्य् अवबाधते । यज्ञस्यैव पदे करोति ।

2.s: gāyatro 'sīti pratamam ādhim ādadhāti | tejo vai brahma gāyatrī | teja eva brahma yajamāne dadhāti |
2.d: गायत्रो ऽसीति प्रतमम् आधिम् आदधाति । तेजो वै ब्रह्म गायत्री । तेज एव ब्रह्म यजमाने दधाति ।

2.s: traiṣṭubho 'sīti dvitīyam ādhim ādadhāty | ojo vai vīryaṃ triṣṭub | oja eva vīryaṃ yajamāne dadhāti |
2.d: त्रैष्टुभो ऽसीति द्वितीयम् आधिम् आदधात्य् । ओजो वै वीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् । ओज एव वीर्यं यजमाने दधाति ।

2.s: jāgato 'sīti tṛtīyam ādhim ādadhāti | paśavo vai jagatī | paśūn eva yajamāne dadhāti |
2.d: जागतो ऽसीति तृतीयम् आधिम् आदधाति । पशवो वै जगती । पशून् एव यजमाने दधाति ।

2.s: makho 'sīti makham evainaṃ karoti |
2.d: मखो ऽसीति मखम् एवैनं करोति ।

2.s: makhasya rāsnāsīti rāsnām karoti | yajño vai makho | yajñāyaivainaṅ karoti | prādeśamātro bhavaty | etāvad vai mukhaṃ | mukhaṃ devānām agnir | mukhena sammita upariṣṭāt pātro bhavati devatānāṃ tṛptyai | tṛpyati prajayā paśubhir | upainaṃ somapītho namati ya evaṃ veda |
2.d: मखस्य रास्नासीति रास्नाम् करोति । यज्ञो वै मखो । यज्ञायैवैनङ् करोति । प्रादेशमात्रो भवत्य् । एतावद् वै मुखं । मुखं देवानाम् अग्निर् । मुखेन सम्मित उपरिष्टात् पात्रो भवति देवतानां तृप्त्यै । तृप्यति प्रजया पशुभिर् । उपैनं सोमपीथो नमति य एवं वेद ।

2.s: sūryasya harasā śrāyety ātape nidadhāty | amuṣyaivainam ādityasya tejasā tapati | pūrvampūrvaṃ sādayatīmān eva lokān rohati |
2.d: सूर्यस्य हरसा श्रायेत्य् आतपे निदधात्य् । अमुष्यैवैनम् आदित्यस्य तेजसा तपति । पूर्वम्पूर्वं सादयतीमान् एव लोकान् रोहति ।
2.m: He heats it with the fiery energy of that sun yonder. He sets each previous one down; he climbs these worlds alone. 22 With "You are the horse dung of the stallion, belonging to Prajāpati," he mutters over the horse dung. The horse indeed belongs to Prajāpati; he accomplishes it through its proper form alone. 23 With "May the wives of the gods fumigate you with the dung of the stallion horse," he fumigates with horse dung. 24 The horse indeed belongs to Prajāpati, the sacrifice to Prajāpati, for common origin. With "For flame to you, for glow to you, for heat to you," he places śamī branches around it. Fire is fiery energy, śamī branches are fiery energy; he places fiery energy in fiery energy alone. 25 With "Of Mitra, the supporter of the peoples," he worships [it]. He prepares it for Mitra alone. 26 With "May the god Savitṛ bake you," he bakes it at Savitṛ's impulse. 27 With "Unwavering on the earth, fill the quarters and directions," [he recites]. Therefore fire shines out in all directions. 28 With "Stand up, become great, stand upright, you are firm," he strengthens it alone. 29 With "Here do I supply this one, son of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, with fiery energy and priestly splendor," [he addresses] a brahman. The Gāyatrī is fiery energy and the priesthood; with fiery energy and priestly splendor he supplies him. 30 If he should practice sorcery, [he says:] "Here do I deprive this one, son of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, of fiery energy and priestly splendor." The Gāyatrī is fiery energy and the priesthood; he deprives him of fiery energy and priestly splendor. 31 With "Here do I supply this one, son of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, with might and valor," [he addresses] a rājanya. The Triṣṭubh is might and valor; with might and valor he supplies him. 32 If he should practice sorcery, [he says:] "Here do I deprive this one, son of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, of might and valor." 33 The Triṣṭubh is might and valor; he deprives him of might and valor. 24 With "Here do I supply this one, son of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, with nourishment and cattle," [he addresses] a vaiśya. The Jagatī is cattle.

2.s: vṛṣṇo niṣpad asi prājāpatyam ity aśvaśakāni vyāharati | prājāpatyo vā aśvo | rūpeṇaivainaṃ samardhayati |
2.d: वृष्णो निष्पद् असि प्राजापत्यम् इत्य् अश्वशकानि व्याहरति । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वो । रूपेणैवैनं समर्धयति ।

2.s: devānān tvā patnīr vṛṣṇo aśvasya niṣpadā dhūpayantv ity aśvaśakair dhūpayati | prājāpatyo vā aśvo | yajñaṃ prajāpatis sayonitvāya
2.d: देवानान् त्वा पत्नीर् वृष्णो अश्वस्य निष्पदा धूपयन्त्व् इत्य् अश्वशकैर् धूपयति । प्राजापत्यो वा अश्वो । यज्ञं प्रजापतिस् सयोनित्वाय

2.s: arciṣe tvā śociṣe tvā harase tveti śamīśākhā abhyādadhāti | tejo vā agnis tejaś śamīśākhās | tejasy eva tejo dadhāti |
2.d: अर्चिषे त्वा शोचिषे त्वा हरसे त्वेति शमीशाखा अभ्यादधाति । तेजो वा अग्निस् तेजश् शमीशाखास् । तेजस्य् एव तेजो दधाति ।

2.s: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛta ity upatiṣṭhate | mitrāyaivainaṅ karoti |
2.d: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृत इत्य् उपतिष्ठते । मित्रायैवैनङ् करोति ।

2.s: devas tvā savitrodvapatv iti sāvitrodvapati prasūtyā |
2.d: देवस् त्वा सवित्रोद्वपत्व् इति सावित्रोद्वपति प्रसूत्या ।

2.s: avyathamānaḥ pṛthivyām āśā diśa āpṛṇeti | tasmād agnis sarvā diśo vibhāti |
2.d: अव्यथमानः पृथिव्याम् आशा दिश आपृणेति । तस्माद् अग्निस् सर्वा दिशो विभाति ।

2.s: uttiṣṭha bṛhan bhavordhvas tiṣṭha dhruvas tvam iti dṛṃhaty evainam |
2.d: उत्तिष्ठ बृहन् भवोर्ध्वस् तिष्ठ ध्रुवस् त्वम् इति दृंहत्य् एवैनम् ।

2.s: idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ tejasā brahmavarcasena samardhayāmīti brāhmaṇaṃ | tejo vai brahma gāyatrī | tejasaivainaṃ brahmavarcasena samardhayati |
2.d: इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रं तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन समर्धयामीति ब्राह्मणं । तेजो वै ब्रह्म गायत्री । तेजसैवैनं ब्रह्मवर्चसेन समर्धयति ।

2.s: yady abhicared idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putran tejasā brahmavarcasena vyardhayāmīti | tejo vai brahma gāyatrī | tejasā brahmavarcasena vyardhayati
2.d: यद्य् अभिचरेद् इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रन् तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन व्यर्धयामीति । तेजो वै ब्रह्म गायत्री । तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेन व्यर्धयति

2.s: idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ojasā vīryeṇa samardhayāmīti rājanyam | ojo vai vīryaṃ triṣṭub | ojasaivainaṃ vīryeṇa samardhayati |
2.d: इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् ओजसा वीर्येण समर्धयामीति राजन्यम् । ओजो वै वीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् । ओजसैवैनं वीर्येण समर्धयति ।

2.s: yady abhicared idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ojasā vīryeṇa vyardhayāmīty | ojo vai vīryaṃ triṣṭub | ojasaivainaṃ vīryeṇa vyardhayati
2.d: यद्य् अभिचरेद् इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् ओजसा वीर्येण व्यर्धयामीत्य् । ओजो वै वीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् । ओजसैवैनं वीर्येण व्यर्धयति

2.s: idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ūrjā paśubhis samardhayāmīti | vaiśyam paśavo vai jagaty | ūrjaivainam paśubhis samardhayati |
2.d: इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् ऊर्जा पशुभिस् समर्धयामीति । वैश्यम् पशवो वै जगत्य् । ऊर्जैवैनम् पशुभिस् समर्धयति ।
2.m: With nourishment, with cattle he prospers him. If he should practice sorcery, [he should say,] 'Here I deprive so-and-so, son of so-and-so, the son of such-and-such mother, of nourishment, of cattle.' Cattle are the Jagatī; with nourishment, with cattle he deprives him. 'Here I prosper myself with fiery energy, with priestly splendor, with might, with valor, with offspring, with cattle, with proper food.' The self is in priestly splendor; he thus prospers his own self with fiery energy, with priestly splendor, with might, with valor, with offspring, with cattle, with proper food. 'For the upright one thee, for the straight one thee, for good dwelling thee'—according to the yajus he sets down each subsequent [pot]; he thus steps down upon these worlds. 'I gaze upon thee with the eye of the Sun,' he looks [at it]. If he were to look at this with the eye of humans, it would burn their sight and the creatures would be born blind; with the eye of the Sun he gazes upon it. 'May speech sprinkle thee': he sprinkles it with milk. Speech indeed is Gāyatrī; with speech he sprinkles it. 'May nourishment sprinkle thee': nourishment is food; with proper food he sprinkles it. 'May milk sprinkle thee': cattle are milk; with cattle he sprinkles it. 'May sap sprinkle thee,' 'May the oblation sprinkle thee,' 'May Soma sprinkle thee,' 'May the sacrifice sprinkle thee,' 'May the brahman sprinkle thee,' 'May Prajāpati sprinkle thee'—according to the yajus. 'O brahman, we shall proceed with the Pravargya,' the adhvaryu addresses the brahman priest. For at that moment the sacrifice rests in the brahman priest; therefore he addresses him. 'Yoked with yajus,' the brahman priest [answers]. A chariot of yajus indeed is this sacrifice; the adhvaryu yokes it in the sacrificial rite. That is the adhvaryu-ship of the adhvaryu. The adhvaryu conducts it; the adhvaryu alone is the leader of all this. The adhvaryu gives commands to the other priests; saying 'Do this, do that,' he thus directs them. 'Let them be fashioned with sāmans': the sāmans are its wheels on both sides. 'Prepared with all thoughts': with all thoughts indeed the sacrifice is prepared.

2.s: yady abhicared idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ūrjā paśubhir vyardhayāmīti | paśavo vai jagaty | ūrjaivainam paśubhir vyardhayati
2.d: यद्य् अभिचरेद् इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् ऊर्जा पशुभिर् व्यर्धयामीति । पशवो वै जगत्य् । ऊर्जैवैनम् पशुभिर् व्यर्धयति

2.s: idam aham mān tejasā brahmavarcasenaujasā vīryeṇa prajayā paśubhir annādyena samardhayāmīty | ātmā vai brahmavarcasy | ātmānam eva tat tejasā brahmavarcasenaujasā vīryeṇa prajayā paśubhir annādyena samardhayaty |
2.d: इदम् अहम् मान् तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेनौजसा वीर्येण प्रजया पशुभिर् अन्नाद्येन समर्धयामीत्य् । आत्मा वै ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् । आत्मानम् एव तत् तेजसा ब्रह्मवर्चसेनौजसा वीर्येण प्रजया पशुभिर् अन्नाद्येन समर्धयत्य् ।

2.s: ṛjave tvā sādhave tvā sukṣityai tveti | yathāyajur aparamaparaṃ sādayatīmān eva lokān pratyavarohati |
2.d: ऋजवे त्वा साधवे त्वा सुक्षित्यै त्वेति । यथायजुर् अपरमपरं सादयतीमान् एव लोकान् प्रत्यवरोहति ।

2.s: sūryasya tvā cakṣusānvīkṣa ity avekṣate | yad vā idam manuṣyāṇāṃ cakṣuṣā prekṣeta pradahec cakṣur andhāḥ prajā jāyeran | sūryasyaivainañ cakṣuṣānvīkṣate |
2.d: सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुसान्वीक्ष इत्य् अवेक्षते । यद् वा इदम् मनुष्याणां चक्षुषा प्रेक्षेत प्रदहेच् चक्षुर् अन्धाः प्रजा जायेरन् । सूर्यस्यैवैनञ् चक्षुषान्वीक्षते ।

2.s: śchṛṇattu tvā vāg iti payasāśchṛṇatti vāg vai gāyatrī vācaivainam āśchṛṇatti
2.d: श्छृणत्तु त्वा वाग् इति पयसाश्छृणत्ति वाग् वै गायत्री वाचैवैनम् आश्छृणत्ति

2.s: śchṛṇattu tvorg ity | annaṃ vā ūrg | annādyenaivainam āśchṛṇatti |
2.d: श्छृणत्तु त्वोर्ग् इत्य् । अन्नं वा ऊर्ग् । अन्नाद्येनैवैनम् आश्छृणत्ति ।

2.s: ṣchṛṇattu tvā paya iti | paśavo vai payaṃ | paśubhir evainam āśchṛṇatti |
2.d: ष्छृणत्तु त्वा पय इति । पशवो वै पयं । पशुभिर् एवैनम् आश्छृणत्ति ।

2.s: śchṛṇattu tvā rasaḥ
2.d: श्छृणत्तु त्वा रसः

2.s: chṛṇattu tvā haviḥ
2.d: छृणत्तु त्वा हविः

2.s: chṛṇattu tvā somaḥ
2.d: छृणत्तु त्वा सोमः

2.s: chṛṇattu tvā yajñaḥ
2.d: छृणत्तु त्वा यज्ञः

2.s: chṛṇattu tvā brahma
2.d: छृणत्तु त्वा ब्रह्म

2.s: chṛṇattu tvā prajāpatir iti yathāyajuḥ |
2.d: छृणत्तु त्वा प्रजापतिर् इति यथायजुः ।

2.s: brahman pravargyeṇa pracariṣyāma ity adhvaryur brahmāṇam āmantrayate | brahmaṇi vā etarhi yajñas | tasmād enam āha |
2.d: ब्रह्मन् प्रवर्ग्येण प्रचरिष्याम इत्य् अध्वर्युर् ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्रयते । ब्रह्मणि वा एतर्हि यज्ञस् । तस्माद् एनम् आह ।

2.s: yajuryuktam iti brahmā | yajuṣo vā eṣa ratho yad yajñas | tam adhvaryur adhvare yunakti | tad adhvaryor adhvaryutvam | adhvaryur enam praṇayaty | adhvaryur evāsya sarvasya praṇetādhvaryur anyān ṛtvijas sampreṣyatīdaṅ kurutedaṅ kurutety evaitad āha |
2.d: यजुर्युक्तम् इति ब्रह्मा । यजुषो वा एष रथो यद् यज्ञस् । तम् अध्वर्युर् अध्वरे युनक्ति । तद् अध्वर्योर् अध्वर्युत्वम् । अध्वर्युर् एनम् प्रणयत्य् । अध्वर्युर् एवास्य सर्वस्य प्रणेताध्वर्युर् अन्यान् ऋत्विजस् सम्प्रेष्यतीदङ् कुरुतेदङ् कुरुतेत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

2.s: sāmabhir āktakhan tveti | sāmāny evāsyābhitaś cakre |
2.d: सामभिर् आक्तखन् त्वेति । सामान्य् एवास्याभितश् चक्रे ।

2.s: viśvābhir dhībhis sambhṛtam iti | sarvābhir vai dhībhir yajñas sambhriyate | sarvābhir eva dhībhir yajamāno yajñaṃ sambharati |
2.d: विश्वाभिर् धीभिस् सम्भृतम् इति । सर्वाभिर् वै धीभिर् यज्ञस् सम्भ्रियते । सर्वाभिर् एव धीभिर् यजमानो यज्ञं सम्भरति ।
2.m: With all thoughts the sacrificer prepares the sacrifice. 'Extended, able to lead across with priestly gifts': 'spread out, reaching the other shore through priestly gifts,' so he says. 'Let the chants carry [it], being well-minded': the hotra invocations are indeed the chants; they indeed now bear the sacrifice. 'Bhūr bhuvas svar om': this indeed is the truth of speech; with that which is the truth of speech he proceeds along with it. 'Proceed, having Indra,' [he says,] for having Indra. 'By the eastern direction, with Agni as the deity, with the Gāyatrī meter, I enter the spring season': they enter both the east and spring from the east, to prevent burning. 'By the southern direction, with Indra as the deity, with the Triṣṭubh meter, I enter the summer season': they enter both the south and summer from the south, to prevent burning. 'By the western direction, with Savitṛ as the deity, with the Jagatī meter, I enter the rainy season': they enter both the west and the rainy season from the west, to prevent burning. 'By the northern direction, with Mitra and Varuṇa as the deities, with the Anuṣṭubh meter, I enter the autumn season': they enter both the north and autumn from the north, to prevent burning. 'By the upward direction, with Bṛhaspati as the deity, with the Paṅkti meter, I enter the winter season': they enter both the zenith and winter from above, to prevent burning. 'By this direction, with Prajāpati as the deity, with the uninterrupted meter, I enter the dewy season': they enter both this [earth] and the dewy season from it, to prevent burning. 'I enter the Gāyatrī meter': fiery energy and the sacred word are Gāyatrī; they enter fiery energy, to prevent burning. 'I enter the Triṣṭubh meter': might and valor are Triṣṭubh; they enter might, to prevent burning. 'I enter the Jagatī meter': cattle are Jagatī; they enter cattle, to prevent burning. 'I enter the Anuṣṭubh meter': speech is Anuṣṭubh;

2.s: dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratatam pārayiṣṇum iti | vitatam pāragaṃ dakṣiṇābhir ity evaitad āha |
2.d: दक्षिणाभिः प्रततम् पारयिष्णुम् इति । विततम् पारगं दक्षिणाभिर् इत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

2.s: stubho vahantu sumanasyamānā iti | hotrā vai stubhas | tā vā etarhi yajñaṃ vahanti |
2.d: स्तुभो वहन्तु सुमनस्यमाना इति । होत्रा वै स्तुभस् । ता वा एतर्हि यज्ञं वहन्ति ।

2.s: bhūr bhuvas svar om ity | etad vai vācas satyaṃ | yad eva vācas satyan tenainaṃ saha pracarati
2.d: भूर् भुवस् स्वर् ओम् इत्य् । एतद् वै वाचस् सत्यं । यद् एव वाचस् सत्यन् तेनैनं सह प्रचरति

2.s: in dravantaḥ pracarateti sendratvāya |
2.d: इन् द्रवन्तः प्रचरतेति सेन्द्रत्वाय ।

2.s: prācyā tvā diśāgninā devatayā gāyatreṇa śchandasā vasantam ṛtum praviśāmīti | prācīñ caiva vasantañ ca purastāt praviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: प्राच्या त्वा दिशाग्निना देवतया गायत्रेण श्छन्दसा वसन्तम् ऋतुम् प्रविशामीति । प्राचीञ् चैव वसन्तञ् च पुरस्तात् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: dakṣiṇayā tvā diśendreṇa devatayā traiṣṭubhena śchandasā grīṣmam ṛtum praviśāmīti | dakṣiṇān caiva grīṣmañ ca dakṣiṇataḥ praviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: दक्षिणया त्वा दिशेन्द्रेण देवतया त्रैष्टुभेन श्छन्दसा ग्रीष्मम् ऋतुम् प्रविशामीति । दक्षिणान् चैव ग्रीष्मञ् च दक्षिणतः प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: pratīcyā tvā diśā savitrā devatayā jāgatena śchandasā varṣā ṛtum praviśāmīti | pratīcīñ caiva varṣāś ca paścāt praviśanty apradāhāya
2.d: प्रतीच्या त्वा दिशा सवित्रा देवतया जागतेन श्छन्दसा वर्षा ऋतुम् प्रविशामीति । प्रतीचीञ् चैव वर्षाश् च पश्चात् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय

2.s: udīcyā tvā diśā mitrāvaruṇābhyān devatayāṇuṣṭubhena śchandasā śaradam ṛtum praviśāmīty | udīcīñ caiva śaradañ cottarāt praviśanty apradāhāya
2.d: उदीच्या त्वा दिशा मित्रावरुणाभ्यान् देवतयाणुष्टुभेन श्छन्दसा शरदम् ऋतुम् प्रविशामीत्य् । उदीचीञ् चैव शरदञ् चोत्तरात् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय

2.s: urdhvayā tvā diśā bṛhaspatinā devatayā pāṅktena śchandasā hemantam ṛtum praviśāmīty | ūrdhvāñ caiva himāñ copariṣṭāt praviśanty apradāhāya
2.d: उर्ध्वया त्वा दिशा बृहस्पतिना देवतया पाङ्क्तेन श्छन्दसा हेमन्तम् ऋतुम् प्रविशामीत्य् । ऊर्ध्वाञ् चैव हिमाञ् चोपरिष्टात् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय

2.s: anayā tvā diśā prajāpatinā devatayānāptena śchandasā śiśiram ṛtum praviśāmīti imāñ caiva śiśirañ cāsyāḥ paraviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: अनया त्वा दिशा प्रजापतिना देवतयानाप्तेन श्छन्दसा शिशिरम् ऋतुम् प्रविशामीति इमाञ् चैव शिशिरञ् चास्याः परविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: gāyatrīṃ chandaḥ praviśāmīti | tejo vai brahma gāyatrī | teja eva tat praviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: गायत्रीं छन्दः प्रविशामीति । तेजो वै ब्रह्म गायत्री । तेज एव तत् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: triṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ praviśāmīty | ojo vai vīryaṃ triṣṭub | oja eva tata praviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: त्रिष्टुभं छन्दः प्रविशामीत्य् । ओजो वै वीर्यं त्रिष्टुब् । ओज एव तत प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: jagatīṃ chandaḥ praviśāmīti | paśavo vai jagatī | paśūn eva tat praviśanty apradāhāya
2.d: जगतीं छन्दः प्रविशामीति । पशवो वै जगती । पशून् एव तत् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय

2.s: anuṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ praviśāmīti | vāg vā anuṣṭub | vācam eva tat praviśanty apradāhāya | paṅktīṃ chandaḥ praviśāmīti | yajño vai paṅktir | yajñaṃ tad praviśanty apradāhāya
2.d: अनुष्टुभं छन्दः प्रविशामीति । वाग् वा अनुष्टुब् । वाचम् एव तत् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय । पङ्क्तीं छन्दः प्रविशामीति । यज्ञो वै पङ्क्तिर् । यज्ञं तद् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय
2.m: they enter speech, to prevent burning. 'I enter the Paṅkti meter': sacrifice is Paṅkti; they enter sacrifice, to prevent burning. 'I enter the Atichandas meter': the meters are the Atichandas; they enter the meters, to prevent burning. 'I enter the meters': cattle are the meters; they enter cattle, to prevent burning. 'May they lead us across, may they protect us': he thus utters a blessing. 'May he meet with those [evils] who hates us and whom we hate': the one whom he hates, upon him he inflicts pain. 'May the waters enter us, may the waters keep watch in us': the waters are all the deities; they enter the deities, to prevent burning. 'Life, full life, may I attain all life': 'May I attain the complete life-span,' so he says. He reaches the full life-span who knows thus, and he makes both the year and the directions an armor on every side. 'For Yama thee, for Makha thee,' he sprinkles the Mahāvīra. Makha is the sacrifice; for the sacrifice he sprinkles it. … The pratiprasthātṛ sets out the sprinkled [implements]. … they proceed. 'O divine guide, thee that art worthy of offering, thee that art worthy of heaven': with the grass broom he wipes the Mahāvīra. Then he wipes it three times, for the gods are threefold in truth. He wipes it all around; thereby he makes it pure and sacrificial on all sides. 'Protect from contact with the earth': he slides silver beneath [it]. These worlds were afraid of the Mahāvīra when it was being heated: 'It will burn all of us with its fiery energy!' They ran to Prajāpati. That Prajāpati said to the earth: 'Becoming silver, bear the Mahāvīra.' He said to the atmosphere: 'With trees I will intervene between you.' He said to heaven: 'Becoming gold, endure the Mahāvīra from above.' Therefore he slides silver beneath [it], to prevent burning of the earth. 'Flame art thou, blaze art thou' …

2.s: atiśchandasaṃ chandaḥ praviśāmīti | śchandāṃsi vā atiśchandāś | chandāṃsy eva tat praviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: अतिश्छन्दसं छन्दः प्रविशामीति । श्छन्दांसि वा अतिश्छन्दाश् । छन्दांस्य् एव तत् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: śchandāṃsi praviśāmīti | paśavo vai śchandāṃsi | paśūn eva tat praviśanty apradāhāya |
2.d: श्छन्दांसि प्रविशामीति । पशवो वै श्छन्दांसि । पशून् एव तत् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: tāni naḥ pārayantu | tāni no 'vantv ity | āśiṣam evāśāste |
2.d: तानि नः पारयन्तु । तानि नो ऽवन्त्व् इत्य् । आशिषम् एवाशास्ते ।

2.s: tāni sa ṛśchatu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yañ ca vayaṃ dviṣma iti | yam eva dveṣṭi taṃ śucārpayaty |
2.d: तानि स ऋश्छतु यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यञ् च वयं द्विष्म इति । यम् एव द्वेष्टि तं शुचार्पयत्य् ।

2.s: āpo asmān praviśantv āpo asmāsu jāgṛtety | āpas sarvā devatā devatā eva tat praviśanty apradāhāya
2.d: आपो अस्मान् प्रविशन्त्व् आपो अस्मासु जागृतेत्य् । आपस् सर्वा देवता देवता एव तत् प्रविशन्त्य् अप्रदाहाय

2.s: āyur viśvāyur viśvam āyur vyaśnavai sarvam āyur vyaśnavā ity evaitad āha | sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ vedātho saṃvatsarañ caiva diśaś ca sarvato varma kurute |
2.d: आयुर् विश्वायुर् विश्वम् आयुर् व्यश्नवै सर्वम् आयुर् व्यश्नवा इत्य् एवैतद् आह । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेदाथो संवत्सरञ् चैव दिशश् च सर्वतो वर्म कुरुते ।

2.s: yamāya tvā makhāya tveti mahāvīram prokṣati | yajño vai makho | yajñāyaivainam prokṣati | prokṣitāni pratiprasthātā vyāyātayati | pracaranti |
2.d: यमाय त्वा मखाय त्वेति महावीरम् प्रोक्षति । यज्ञो वै मखो । यज्ञायैवैनम् प्रोक्षति । प्रोक्षितानि प्रतिप्रस्थाता व्यायातयति । प्रचरन्ति ।

2.s: deva puraścara rghyāsaṃ tvā svarghyāsan tveti | vedena mahāvīraṃ sammārṣṭi | athaivainaṃ tris sammārṣṭi | triṣatyā hi devās | sarvatas sammārṣṭi | sarvata evainam medhyaṃ yajñiyan tena karoti |
2.d: देव पुरश्चर र्घ्यासं त्वा स्वर्घ्यासन् त्वेति । वेदेन महावीरं सम्मार्ष्टि । अथैवैनं त्रिस् सम्मार्ष्टि । त्रिषत्या हि देवास् । सर्वतस् सम्मार्ष्टि । सर्वत एवैनम् मेध्यं यज्ञियन् तेन करोति ।

2.s: pṛthivyās saṃspṛśas pāhīti | rajatam adhastād adhikarṣatīme vai lokā mahāvīrāt pravṛjyamānād abibhayus | sarvān no 'yan tejasoddhakṣyatīti | prajāpatim upādhāvan | sa prajāpatiḥ pṛthivīm abravīd rajata bhūtvā mahāvīraṃ dhārayasvety | antarikṣam abravīd vanaspatibhis tvāntar dhāsyāmīti | divam abravīd dharitā bhūtvopariṣṭān mahāvīram sahasveti | tasmād rajatam adhastād adhikarṣati pṛthivyā apradāhāya
2.d: पृथिव्यास् संस्पृशस् पाहीति । रजतम् अधस्ताद् अधिकर्षतीमे वै लोका महावीरात् प्रवृज्यमानाद् अबिभयुस् । सर्वान् नो ऽयन् तेजसोद्धक्ष्यतीति । प्रजापतिम् उपाधावन् । स प्रजापतिः पृथिवीम् अब्रवीद् रजत भूत्वा महावीरं धारयस्वेत्य् । अन्तरिक्षम् अब्रवीद् वनस्पतिभिस् त्वान्तर् धास्यामीति । दिवम् अब्रवीद् धरिता भूत्वोपरिष्टान् महावीरम् सहस्वेति । तस्माद् रजतम् अधस्ताद् अधिकर्षति पृथिव्या अप्रदाहाय

2.s: arcir asi śocir asīti | jvalantam agniṃ haratas satejastvāya
2.d: अर्चिर् असि शोचिर् असीति । ज्वलन्तम् अग्निं हरतस् सतेजस्त्वाय
2.m: They carry the blazing fire, for fiery energy. With "Whom they anoint..." [RV 5.43.7], he joins the principal Mahāvīra on it. Agni is fiery energy, the Mahāvīra is fiery energy; into fiery energy he places fiery energy. "To out-breath, svāhā! To cross-breath, svāhā! To down-breath, svāhā!" He joins the Gharma Mahāvīra. The quarters indeed feared the Mahāvīra when he was set on the fire: "This one will burn us all up with fiery energy!" They ran to Prajāpati. Prajāpati said: "Span by span he burns you; I shall interpose [deities] between him and you with the deities." Therefore, by a span, he measures the quarters. "Unassailable from the east, under Agni's overlordship": he interposes Agni from the east to prevent burning. "Grant me life": he invokes this blessing for himself. "Rich in sons from the south, under Indra's overlordship": he interposes Indra from the south to prevent burning. "Grant me offspring": he invokes this blessing for himself. "A good seat from the west, under the divine Savitṛ's overlordship": he interposes Savitṛ from the west to prevent burning. "Grant me sight": he invokes this blessing for himself. "Hearing from the north, under Mitra and Varuṇa's overlordship": he interposes Mitra and Varuṇa from the north to prevent burning. "Grant me hearing": he invokes this blessing for himself. "Support from above, under Bṛhaspati's overlordship": he interposes Bṛhaspati from above to prevent burning. "Grant me speech": he invokes this blessing for himself. With "... svāhā", the two enclose it. Yonder sun is Rudra, the Mahāvīra; the Maruts are the rays; with the rays the two enclose him. With "You are the screen of the intermediate space", he lays a kindling-stick on top; with trees indeed he screens it from above. With "Protect from contact with heaven", he covers it with a gold piece to prevent the burning of heaven. "Worthy, you bear the arrows and the bow; worthy, the worshipful neck-ornament of every form; / worthy, you distribute this entire immense world; nor is there anyone mightier than you, Rudra" [RV 2.33.10]—

2.s: añjanti yam iti tasmin mukhyaṃ mahāvīram prayunakti | tejo vā agnis tejo mahāvīras | tejasy eva tejo dadhāti |
2.d: अञ्जन्ति यम् इति तस्मिन् मुख्यं महावीरम् प्रयुनक्ति । तेजो वा अग्निस् तेजो महावीरस् । तेजस्य् एव तेजो दधाति ।

2.s: prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāhāpānāya svāheti | mahāvīraṃ gharmyam prayunakti | diśo vai mahāvīrāt pravṛktād abibhayus sarvā no 'yan tejasoddhakṣyatīti | tāḥ prajāpatim upādhāvan | sa prajāpatir abravīt prādeśaṃprādeśaṃ vaḥ pradahati | devatābhir vo 'ntar dhāsyāmīti | tasmāt prādeśena diśo mimīte |
2.d: प्राणाय स्वाहा व्यानाय स्वाहापानाय स्वाहेति । महावीरं घर्म्यम् प्रयुनक्ति । दिशो वै महावीरात् प्रवृक्ताद् अबिभयुस् सर्वा नो ऽयन् तेजसोद्धक्ष्यतीति । ताः प्रजापतिम् उपाधावन् । स प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीत् प्रादेशंप्रादेशं वः प्रदहति । देवताभिर् वो ऽन्तर् धास्यामीति । तस्मात् प्रादेशेन दिशो मिमीते ।

2.s: 'nādhṛṣṭā purastād agner ādhipatya ity | agnim eva purastād antar dadhāty apradāhāya
2.d: ऽनाधृष्टा पुरस्ताद् अग्नेर् आधिपत्य इत्य् । अग्निम् एव पुरस्ताद् अन्तर् दधात्य् अप्रदाहाय

2.s: ayur me dā ity ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste |
2.d: अयुर् मे दा इत्य् आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते ।

2.s: putravatī dakṣiṇata indrasyādhipatya itīndram eva dakṣiṇād antar dadhāty apradāhāya |
2.d: पुत्रवती दक्षिणत इन्द्रस्याधिपत्य इतीन्द्रम् एव दक्षिणाद् अन्तर् दधात्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: prajāṃ me dā ity ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste |
2.d: प्रजां मे दा इत्य् आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते ।

2.s: suṣadā paścād devasya savitur ādhipatya iti | savitāram eva paścād antar dadhāty apradāhāya |
2.d: सुषदा पश्चाद् देवस्य सवितुर् आधिपत्य इति । सवितारम् एव पश्चाद् अन्तर् दधात्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: cakṣur me dā ity ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāsta |
2.d: चक्षुर् मे दा इत्य् आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्त ।

2.s: āśrutir uttarān mitrāvaruṇayor ādhipatya iti mitrāvaruṇā evottarād antar dadhāty apradāhāya |
2.d: आश्रुतिर् उत्तरान् मित्रावरुणयोर् आधिपत्य इति मित्रावरुणा एवोत्तराद् अन्तर् दधात्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: śrotraṃ me dā ity ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste |
2.d: श्रोत्रं मे दा इत्य् आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते ।

2.s: vidhṛtir upariṣṭād bṛhaspater ādhipatya iti | bṛhaspatim evopariṣṭād antar dadhāty apradāhāya |
2.d: विधृतिर् उपरिष्टाद् बृहस्पतेर् आधिपत्य इति । बृहस्पतिम् एवोपरिष्टाद् अन्तर् दधात्य् अप्रदाहाय ।

2.s: vācaṃ me dā ity ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste | svāheti pariśrayato | 'sau vā ādityo rudro mahāvīro raśmayo vai maruto | raśmibhir evainam pariśrayato |
2.d: वाचं मे दा इत्य् आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते । स्वाहेति परिश्रयतो । ऽसौ वा आदित्यो रुद्रो महावीरो रश्मयो वै मरुतो । रश्मिभिर् एवैनम् परिश्रयतो ।

2.s: 'ntarikṣasyāntardhir asīty upariṣṭāt samidham ādadhāti | vanaspatibhir evopariṣṭād antar dadhāti |
2.d: ऽन्तरिक्षस्यान्तर्धिर् असीत्य् उपरिष्टात् समिधम् आदधाति । वनस्पतिभिर् एवोपरिष्टाद् अन्तर् दधाति ।

2.s: divas saṃspṛśas pāhīti haritenāpidadhāti divo 'pradāhāya
2.d: दिवस् संस्पृशस् पाहीति हरितेनापिदधाति दिवो ऽप्रदाहाय

2.s: arhan bibharṣi sāyakāni dhanvārhan niṣkaṃ yajataṃ viśvarūpam | arhann idaṃ dayase viśvam abhvan na vā ojīyo rudra tvad astīti | mahimānam evāsyaitad uddharṣayati |
2.d: अर्हन् बिभर्षि सायकानि धन्वार्हन् निष्कं यजतं विश्वरूपम् । अर्हन्न् इदं दयसे विश्वम् अभ्वन् न वा ओजीयो रुद्र त्वद् अस्तीति । महिमानम् एवास्यैतद् उद्धर्षयति ।
2.m: he thereby stirs up his greatness. "You are connected with Gāyatrī, you are connected with Triṣṭubh, you are connected with Jagatī": he hands it to the pratiprasthātṛ. The priests are the priestly functions; to the priestly functions he delivers it. One [fan] to the fire-kindler, [one] to the pratiprasthātṛ. They walk around clockwise. With "Sweetness, sweetness, sweetness!" they fan it; "I will gather bee-sweetness" is what he says. "You are out-breath, you are cross-breath, you are down-breath": out-breath, cross-breath, down-breath—these he places in the sacrificer. "You are hearing": he places hearing in the sacrificer. All the priests go around. The priests are the priestly functions; to the priestly functions he delivers it. With "May Agni fan you...", he fans him with these deities. When it is ablaze, he removes the gold plate. "The divine Gandharva, who is master of the world...": these worlds are the world; of them this one is the overlord, who is Rudra. "... the single, wise, to be praised with mind among the peoples...": "Thee I approach with the prayer, divine deity": if they were to approach him without the holy power, it would harm him. The holy power is auspicious, peaceful; with the holy power he approaches him. "In heaven is your seat": "In heaven is your home" is what he says. "Celebrated in heaven, worshipful, of sun-skin": the gods did not recognize Rudra when he went to the heavenly world, moving in sun-like appearance. They said, "Who are you?" [He said,] "I am Rudra, I am Indra, I am Āditya, I am the dispeller of all divine wrath." They said, "Let us exclude him." Howling, he spoke against them; he rushed toward them. They said, "You are everything (bhavān sarvam)." Because he spoke howling (ruvan), that is Rudra's nature as Rudra; that they said "Lord (bhavān)", that is Bhava's nature as Bhava; that they said "all (sarvam)", that is Śarva's nature as Śarva. He became auspicious (śiva); that is Śiva's nature as Śiva. He was gracious to them; that is Mṛḻa's nature as Mṛḻa. The gods said to him: "Be overlord of what has been and what will be."

2.s: gāyatram asi traiṣṭubham asi jāgatam asīti | pratiprasthātre prayaśchati | hotrā vā ṛtvijo | hotrābhya evainam etat samprayaśchaty | ekam agnidhe pratiprasthātre | pradakṣiṇam pariyanti |
2.d: गायत्रम् असि त्रैष्टुभम् असि जागतम् असीति । प्रतिप्रस्थात्रे प्रयश्छति । होत्रा वा ऋत्विजो । होत्राभ्य एवैनम् एतत् सम्प्रयश्छत्य् । एकम् अग्निधे प्रतिप्रस्थात्रे । प्रदक्षिणम् परियन्ति ।

2.s: madhu madhu madhv iti dhūnvanti | madhu sāraghaṃ sambhariṣyāmīty evaitad āha |
2.d: मधु मधु मध्व् इति धून्वन्ति । मधु सारघं सम्भरिष्यामीत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

2.s: prāṇo 'si vyāno 'sy apāno 'sīti | prāṇaṃ vyānam apānan tān eva yajamāne dadhāti |
2.d: प्राणो ऽसि व्यानो ऽस्य् अपानो ऽसीति । प्राणं व्यानम् अपानन् तान् एव यजमाने दधाति ।

2.s: śrotram asīti śrotram eva yajamāne dadhāti | sarva ṛtvijaḥ pariviśanti | hotrā vā ṛtvijo | hotrābhya evainam etat samprayaśchaty |
2.d: श्रोत्रम् असीति श्रोत्रम् एव यजमाने दधाति । सर्व ऋत्विजः परिविशन्ति । होत्रा वा ऋत्विजो । होत्राभ्य एवैनम् एतत् सम्प्रयश्छत्य् ।

2.s: agniṣ ṭvā dhūnotv ity etābhir evainaṃ devatābhir dhūnoti | prajvalite rukmam apadatte | divyo gandharvo bhuvanasya yas patir ime vai lokā bhuvanaṃ | teṣām eṣo 'dhipatir yo rudraḥ ekāvyo manasā vikṣv īḍya tan tvā yāmi brahmaṇā deva daivyam iti | yad vā enam brahmaṇopacareyur hiṃsyād enam | brahma śivaṃ śāntam | brahmaṇaivainam upacarati |
2.d: अग्निष् ट्वा धूनोत्व् इत्य् एताभिर् एवैनं देवताभिर् धूनोति । प्रज्वलिते रुक्मम् अपदत्ते । दिव्यो गन्धर्वो भुवनस्य यस् पतिर् इमे वै लोका भुवनं । तेषाम् एषो ऽधिपतिर् यो रुद्रः एकाव्यो मनसा विक्ष्व् ईड्य तन् त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा देव दैव्यम् इति । यद् वा एनम् ब्रह्मणोपचरेयुर् हिंस्याद् एनम् । ब्रह्म शिवं शान्तम् । ब्रह्मणैवैनम् उपचरति ।

2.s: divi te sadhastham iti divi te gṛham ity evaitad āha |
2.d: दिवि ते सधस्थम् इति दिवि ते गृहम् इत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

2.s: divi pṛṣṭo yajatas sūryatvag iti | devā vai rudraṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gataṃ na vyajānann ādityavarṇaṃ carantan | te 'bruvan ko 'sīty | ahaṃ rudro 'ham indro 'ham ādityo 'haṃ sarvasyāvayā haraso divyasyeti | te 'bruvan nirbhajāmainam iti | tān ruvann abhyavadat | tān prādhrajat | te 'bruvan bhavān sarvam iti | yad ruvann abhyavadat tad rudrasya rudratvaṃ | yad bhavān iti tad bhavasya bhavatvaṃ yat sarvam iti tac charvasya śarvatvaṃ | sa śivo 'bhavat | tac chivasya śivatvaṃ | tebhyo 'mṛḷata | tan mṛḷasya mṛḷatvaṃ | taṃ devā abruvan bhavasya bhūtasya bhavyasyādhipatyam iti | sarvasyādhipatyaṃ yajamānaṃ gamayaty |
2.d: दिवि पृष्टो यजतस् सूर्यत्वग् इति । देवा वै रुद्रं स्वर्गं लोकं गतं न व्यजानन्न् आदित्यवर्णं चरन्तन् । ते ऽब्रुवन् को ऽसीत्य् । अहं रुद्रो ऽहम् इन्द्रो ऽहम् आदित्यो ऽहं सर्वस्यावया हरसो दिव्यस्येति । ते ऽब्रुवन् निर्भजामैनम् इति । तान् रुवन्न् अभ्यवदत् । तान् प्राध्रजत् । ते ऽब्रुवन् भवान् सर्वम् इति । यद् रुवन्न् अभ्यवदत् तद् रुद्रस्य रुद्रत्वं । यद् भवान् इति तद् भवस्य भवत्वं यत् सर्वम् इति तच् छर्वस्य शर्वत्वं । स शिवो ऽभवत् । तच् छिवस्य शिवत्वं । तेभ्यो ऽमृऌअत । तन् मृऌअस्य मृऌअत्वं । तं देवा अब्रुवन् भवस्य भूतस्य भव्यस्याधिपत्यम् इति । सर्वस्याधिपत्यं यजमानं गमयत्य् ।

2.s: anavadyābhis sam u jagmābhir iti | hotrā vā anavadyās | tābhir vā eṣa pravargye saṅgaśchate tābhir eva pravargyaṃ saṅgamayati | samudra āsāṃ sadanaṃ va āhur iti | vedā vai samudrās | teṣu vā evainam pravargye saṅgamayati | abhriye didyun nakṣatriye yā viśvāvasuṃ gandharvaṃ sacadhve tābhyo namo astu tā no mṛḷayantu tā naś śarma yaśchantu taṃ yan dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭi tam āsāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ | apaśyaṃ gopām anipadyamānam iti | āditya | eṣa lokānāṃ goptā | naiṣa rātrā na divā saṃviśaty |
2.d: अनवद्याभिस् सम् उ जग्माभिर् इति । होत्रा वा अनवद्यास् । ताभिर् वा एष प्रवर्ग्ये सङ्गश्छते ताभिर् एव प्रवर्ग्यं सङ्गमयति । समुद्र आसां सदनं व आहुर् इति । वेदा वै समुद्रास् । तेषु वा एवैनम् प्रवर्ग्ये सङ्गमयति । अभ्रिये दिद्युन् नक्षत्रिये या विश्वावसुं गन्धर्वं सचध्वे ताभ्यो नमो अस्तु ता नो मृऌअयन्तु ता नश् शर्म यश्छन्तु तं यन् द्विष्मो यश् च नो द्वेष्टि तम् आसां जम्भे दध्मः । अपश्यं गोपाम् अनिपद्यमानम् इति । आदित्य । एष लोकानां गोप्ता । नैष रात्रा न दिवा संविशत्य् ।
2.m: He leads the sacrificer to overlordship over everything. "Together with the faultless ones, the gatherings": the priestly functions are the faultless ones; with them he unites at the Pravargya; with them he unites the Pravargya. "The ocean they call your seat": the Vedas are the oceans; in them he unites him at the Pravargya. "... of the clouds, lightning, of the constellations, you who accompany the Gandharva Viśvāvasu, homage be to them; may they be gracious to us, may they grant us protection; him whom we hate and who hates us, him we place in their jaws!" "I saw the herdsman who does not rest": the sun; he is the herdsman of the worlds; he does not rest by night nor by day. "Moving hither and thither along the paths": therefore he wanders along all paths, whether southward or northward. "Clad in those converging and those diverging": four quarters are his converging, four diverging; clad in them he covers these worlds with fiery energy. "Here you protected the sweet thing for the two sweet ones, the sweetness for the two desiring sweetness." "When the Gharma has shone": "I shall gather sweet honey" is what he says. "Agni has met with fire, with the divine Savitṛ, he shines with the sun, svāhā!": here indeed now fire meets with fire. "Agni has met with heat, with the divine Savitṛ, he has shone with the sun. The upholder of heaven shines across the mist, the upholder of the broad intermediate space, the upholder of earth, the upholder god of gods, immortal, born of heat": yonder sun upholds these worlds with fiery energy. "For the heart to you, for the mind to you, for heaven to you, for the sun to you": to yonder world he leads him. "This rite upward!": the sacrificial rite is the sacrifice; [it is] for the upward direction of the sacrifice. "Extend the offerings among the gods in heaven": with the offerings […] "Embryo of the gods, father of thoughts, lord of creatures": for he is the embryo of the gods.

2.s: ā ca parā ca pathibhiś carantam iti | tasmād eṣa sarvān patho 'nusañcarati yad dakṣiṇā yad udaṅ |
2.d: आ च परा च पथिभिश् चरन्तम् इति । तस्माद् एष सर्वान् पथो ऽनुसञ्चरति यद् दक्षिणा यद् उदङ् ।

2.s: sa sadhrīcīs sa viṣūcīr vasāna iti | catasro vā etasya diśas sadhrīcīś catasro viṣūcīs | tā vā eṣa vasāna imāṃ llokāṃs tejasāvṛṇoty |

2.s: sam agnir agnināgata saṃ devena savitrā saṃ sūryeṇa rocate svāhety | atra vā eṣa etarhy agnir agninā saṅgaśchate |

2.d: सम् अग्निस् तपसागत सं देवेन सवित्रा सं सूर्येणारुक्त । धर्ता दिवो रजसो विभाति धर्तोरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्य धर्ता पृथिव्या धर्ता देवो देवानाम् अमर्त्यस् तपोजा इत्य् । असौ वा आदित्य इमां ल्लोकांस् तेजसा धारयति ।

2.s: garbho devānām pitā matīnām patiḥ prajānām iti garbho hy eṣa devānām | pitā matīnām patiḥ prajānām |
2.d: गर्भो देवानाम् पिता मतीनाम् पतिः प्रजानाम् इति गर्भो ह्य् एष देवानाम् । पिता मतीनाम् पतिः प्रजानाम् ।
2.m: “Father of thoughts, lord of creatures!” [With the words,] “A giver of life are you to us, you are Gharma, a giver of luster; you are our father, be our father!” he seeks this blessing for himself. [With the words,] “Homage to you! Do not harm me!” [it is] for the non-injury of himself. [With the words,] “Together with Tvaṣṭṛ may we worship you,” [it is] for procreation, for from him these creatures are born. The head of the sacrifice indeed was severed. At that time, the two Aśvins were non-drinkers of the Gharma, [merely] physicians of the gods. The gods said to them: “You two are physicians; put this head of the sacrifice back in place.” The two said: “Let us choose a boon; let the Pravargya belong to the two of us alone.” The gods said to them: “You two have embraced everything; let there be a share for us here too.” The two said: “Let it be milked first for the two of us; let it be offered first for the two of us.” Therefore, it is milked first for the two of them, and offered first [for them], for it was chosen as a boon by the two of them. The two put the head of the sacrifice back in place. From it, what blood flowed together, from that the udumbara tree arose. When the vessels are made of udumbara wood, he places nourishment right into the sacrifice. What sap there was, that is the muñja grasses; therefore they make the veda broom out of muñja. […] The strainer […]. He calls out: “Come, O so-and-so!” Thus he calls her from the sky. “Come, O so-and-so!” Thus he calls her from the intermediate space. “Come, O so-and-so!” Thus he calls her from the earth. The sacred word is her calf, the Vedas her udders. With the sacred word as the calf, the gods milked speech, cattle, and immortality. Whoever knows the secret names of the Vedas attains a full lifespan, becomes endowed with priestly splendor, finds firm support, and becomes possessed of food, an eater of food. “One is blessing-bringing, one finds wealth, one gives bountifully, one nourishes all.” These indeed are the secret names of the Vedas. He attains a full lifespan, becomes endowed with priestly splendor, finds firm support, and becomes possessed of food, an eater of food, who knows thus. “That breast of yours which is ever-flowing, which brings blessings, which yields treasure, finds wealth, and gives bountifully,

2.s: āyurdās tvam asmabhyaṃ gharmāsi varcodāḥ pitā no 'si pitā no bodhīty ātmana evaitām aśiṣam āśāste |
2.d: आयुर्दास् त्वम् अस्मभ्यं घर्मासि वर्चोदाः पिता नो ऽसि पिता नो बोधीत्य् आत्मन एवैताम् अशिषम् आशास्ते ।

2.s: namas te astu mā mā hiṃsīr ity ātmano 'hiṃsāyai |
2.d: नमस् ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीर् इत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै ।

2.s: tvaṣṭṛmantas tvā sapemety ato hīmāḥ prajāḥ prajāyante prajananāya | yajñasya vai śiro 'schidyata | tā etarhy aśvinā agharmapau bhiṣajau devānām āstāṃ | tau devā abruvan bhiṣajau vai stha idaṃ yajñasya śiraḥ pratidhattam iti | tā abrūtām vāryaṃ vṛṇāvahā āvayor eva pravargyo bhavatv iti | tau devā abruvan sarvaṃ vai paryagṛhṇāthām astu no 'trāpīti | tā abrūtām āvayor agre duhyatām āvayor agre hūyatām iti | tasmād etayor evāgre duhyate 'gre hūyate | vāryavṛtaṃ hy enayos | tau yajñasya śiraḥ pratyadhattān | tato yal lohitaṃ samasravat tata udumbaras samabhavad | yad audumbarāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti yajña evorjaṃ dadhāti | yo rasas te muñjās | tasmān mauñjaṃ vedaṃ kurvanti | pavitra āhvayaty | asā ehīti diva evainām etad āhvayaty |
2.d: त्वष्टृमन्तस् त्वा सपेमेत्य् अतो हीमाः प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते प्रजननाय । यज्ञस्य वै शिरो ऽस्छिद्यत । ता एतर्ह्य् अश्विना अघर्मपौ भिषजौ देवानाम् आस्तां । तौ देवा अब्रुवन् भिषजौ वै स्थ इदं यज्ञस्य शिरः प्रतिधत्तम् इति । ता अब्रूताम् वार्यं वृणावहा आवयोर् एव प्रवर्ग्यो भवत्व् इति । तौ देवा अब्रुवन् सर्वं वै पर्यगृह्णाथाम् अस्तु नो ऽत्रापीति । ता अब्रूताम् आवयोर् अग्रे दुह्यताम् आवयोर् अग्रे हूयताम् इति । तस्माद् एतयोर् एवाग्रे दुह्यते ऽग्रे हूयते । वार्यवृतं ह्य् एनयोस् । तौ यज्ञस्य शिरः प्रत्यधत्तान् । ततो यल् लोहितं समस्रवत् तत उदुम्बरस् समभवद् । यद् औदुम्बराणि पात्राणि भवन्ति यज्ञ एवोर्जं दधाति । यो रसस् ते मुञ्जास् । तस्मान् मौञ्जं वेदं कुर्वन्ति । पवित्र आह्वयत्य् । असा एहीति दिव एवैनाम् एतद् आह्वयत्य् ।

2.s: asā ehīty antarikṣād evainām etad āhvayaty |
2.d: असा एहीत्य् अन्तरिक्षाद् एवैनाम् एतद् आह्वयत्य् ।

2.s: asā ehīti pṛthivyā evainām etad āhvayati | brahma vā etasyā vatso vedās stanā | devā vai brahmaṇā vatsena vācam aduhran paśūṃś cāmṛtañ ca | yo vai vedānāṃ guhyāni nāmāni veda sarvam āyur eti brahmavarcasī bhavati pratitiṣṭhaty annavān annādo bhavati | mayobhūr eko vasuvid ekas sudatra eko viśvapoṣy eka ity | etāni vai vedānāṃ guhyāni nāmāni | sarvam āyur eti brahmavarcasī bhavati pratitiṣṭhaty annavān annādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
2.d: असा एहीति पृथिव्या एवैनाम् एतद् आह्वयति । ब्रह्म वा एतस्या वत्सो वेदास् स्तना । देवा वै ब्रह्मणा वत्सेन वाचम् अदुह्रन् पशूंश् चामृतञ् च । यो वै वेदानां गुह्यानि नामानि वेद सर्वम् आयुर् एति ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति प्रतितिष्ठत्य् अन्नवान् अन्नादो भवति । मयोभूर् एको वसुविद् एकस् सुदत्र एको विश्वपोष्य् एक इत्य् । एतानि वै वेदानां गुह्यानि नामानि । सर्वम् आयुर् एति ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति प्रतितिष्ठत्य् अन्नवान् अन्नादो भवति य एवं वेद ।

2.s: yas te stanaś śaśayo yo mayobhūr yo ratnadhā vasuvid yas sudatraḥ | yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tam iha dhātave kar ity anumantrayate |
2.d: यस् ते स्तनश् शशयो यो मयोभूर् यो रत्नधा वसुविद् यस् सुदत्रः । येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि सरस्वति तम् इह धातवे कर् इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
2.m: with which you nourish all choice things, O Sarasvatī, make that available here to suckle!”—thus he consecrates [her] with a mantra. [With the words,] “You are the turban of Aditi,” having bound her with the halter, he makes her obedient to her rule. [With the words,] “May Pūṣan [lead] you,” he lets the calf loose, for bodily wholeness. [With the words,] “Moo for the Gharma!” he turns [her] around. […] for the Gharma […]. “About to perform the Pravargya tomorrow, he should separate the calf and kid on the previous day; likewise in the morning or evening having released the two cows. Upon the loss of the milk-cow for the Gharma, he should milk the vow-cow from then on. For the Gharma, one should milk half the vow-cow, two udders each here; upon the loss of both the Gharma-cow and vow-cow, the twice-born should proceed with ghee. But upon the loss of the goat, [he should proceed] with cow’s [milk], or bring another cow; upon total loss, he should bring milk drawn from an uncalved cow or curds.” They milk the cow. […] they milk her. They pour out […] when they milk the goat. Right into the Gharma they milk it; indeed they pour out nourishment when they milk the goat. Into the Gharma they bring nourishment together. Therefore they say: “Come to me with your share of nourishment! O Indra and Aśvins, drink the Gharma of bees' honey! O Vasus, worship! Svāhā!” The two pour nourishment down into the Mahāvīra; into the Gharma they bring nourishment together. With [the words], “To the ray of the sun, winning the rain, svāhā!” he recites over that which has ascended upwards. What oblation rises up from here causes the rain to fall from yonder [sky]. By his own oblation he leads down the rain from the sky. With [the words], “You are Gāyatrī-natured, you are Triṣṭubh-natured,” he takes up the two tongs. With [the words], “You are Jagatī-natured,” [he takes up] the supporting ladle. By means of the meters he grasps it. With [the words], “With Heaven and Earth I grasp you,” he grasps the Mahāvīra with the two tongs; these two indeed are the tongs; with these two he grasps it. With [the words], “With the intermediate space I hold you up,” he holds it from below with the supporting ladle; moreover, the supporting ladle is the intermediate space; he holds it right in the intermediate space. [With the words,] “May I be able to bear you, approved by the gods and ancestors!” […] [With the words,] “To the ocean, to the wind, svāhā!” he offers.

2.s: 'dityā uṣṇīṣam asīty | abhidhānyābhidhāya suvratām evaināṃ karoti |
