2.s: pūṣā tveti vatsam upāvasṛjati satanūtvāya |
2.d: पूषा त्वेति वत्सम् उपावसृजति सतनूत्वाय ।

2.s: gharmāya śinkṣvety apavartayati | gharma evaṅ gha śvaś cariṣyan pravargyeṇa pūrvedyur vatsavarkarau | apākuryāt tathā prātaḥ sāyam votsṛjya dhenuke | nāśe gharmaduho dhenvā vratadhenuṃ duhet tataḥ | gharmayārddhavratā duhyād dvaudvau stanau iha | gharmavrataduhor nāśe ājyena pracared dvijaḥ ajānāśe tu gavyenānyāṃ vā dhenum ānayet | sarvanāśe vṛtādugdhaṃ payo vā dadhi vānayet | gām duhanti | hastyauṣṭhya evaināṃ duhaṅ g parāsiñcan yad ajāṃ duhanti | gharma eva tad duhaty | ūrjaṃ vaiṣa tat parāsiñcan yad ajāṃ duhanti | gharma evorjaṃ sambharatas |
2.d: घर्माय शिन्क्ष्वेत्य् अपवर्तयति । घर्म एवङ् घ श्वश् चरिष्यन् प्रवर्ग्येण पूर्वेद्युर् वत्सवर्करौ । अपाकुर्यात् तथा प्रातः सायम् वोत्सृज्य धेनुके । नाशे घर्मदुहो धेन्वा व्रतधेनुं दुहेत् ततः । घर्मयार्द्धव्रता दुह्याद् द्वौद्वौ स्तनौ इह । घर्मव्रतदुहोर् नाशे आज्येन प्रचरेद् द्विजः अजानाशे तु गव्येनान्यां वा धेनुम् आनयेत् । सर्वनाशे वृतादुग्धं पयो वा दधि वानयेत् । गाम् दुहन्ति । हस्त्यौष्ठ्य एवैनां दुहङ् ग् परासिञ्चन् यद् अजां दुहन्ति । घर्म एव तद् दुहत्य् । ऊर्जं वैष तत् परासिञ्चन् यद् अजां दुहन्ति । घर्म एवोर्जं सम्भरतस् ।

2.s: tasmād āhus sahorjo bhāgenopa mehīndrāśvinā madhunas sāraghasya gharmaṃ pāta vasavo yajata vaḷ iti | mahāvīra ūrjam avanayato | gharma evorjaṃ samānayatas |
2.d: तस्माद् आहुस् सहोर्जो भागेनोप मेहीन्द्राश्विना मधुनस् सारघस्य घर्मं पात वसवो यजत वऌ इति । महावीर ऊर्जम् अवनयतो । घर्म एवोर्जं समानयतस् ।

2.s: sūryasya tvā raśmaye vṛṣṭivanaye svāhety ūrdhvam utkrāntam anumantrayate | yā vā ita āhutir udayate sāmuto vṛṣṭiṃ cyāvayati | svayaivāhutyā divo vṛṣṭiṃ ninayati |
2.d: सूर्यस्य त्वा रश्मये वृष्टिवनये स्वाहेत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् उत्क्रान्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते । या वा इत आहुतिर् उदयते सामुतो वृष्टिं च्यावयति । स्वयैवाहुत्या दिवो वृष्टिं निनयति ।

2.s: gāyatro 'si traiṣṭubho 'sīti śaphā ādatte |
2.d: गायत्रो ऽसि त्रैष्टुभो ऽसीति शफा आदत्ते ।

2.s: jāgato 'sīty upayāmaṃ | chandobhir evainam parigṛhṇāti |
2.d: जागतो ऽसीत्य् उपयामं । छन्दोभिर् एवैनम् परिगृह्णाति ।

2.s: dyāvāpṛthivībhyān tvā parigṛhṇāmīti śaphābhyām mahāvīram parigṛhṇāti ime vai śaphā | ābhyām evainam parigṛhṇāty |
2.d: द्यावापृथिवीभ्यान् त्वा परिगृह्णामीति शफाभ्याम् महावीरम् परिगृह्णाति इमे वै शफा । आभ्याम् एवैनम् परिगृह्णात्य् ।

2.s: antarikṣeṇa tvopayaśchāmīty adhastād upayāmena dhārayaty | atho antarikṣaṃ vā upayāmo | 'ntarikṣa evainan dhārayati |
2.d: अन्तरिक्षेण त्वोपयश्छामीत्य् अधस्ताद् उपयामेन धारयत्य् । अथो अन्तरिक्षं वा उपयामो । ऽन्तरिक्ष एवैनन् धारयति ।

2.s: devānān tvā pitṝṇām anumato bhartuṃ śakeyam iti | sa mudrāya tvā vātāya svāheti juhoti | yathāyajur yaj juhuyād rudrāya paśūn apidadhyād apaśus syād | yajur eva vaded | rudrād eva paśūn parivṛṇakti | sarvā vā etarhy etasmin devatā āśaṃsante mahyaṃ hoṣyati mahyaṃ hoṣyatīti | devatā evainam abhidhyāyantīs tā enam abhāgā īśvarā hiṃstor |
2.d: देवानान् त्वा पितॄणाम् अनुमतो भर्तुं शकेयम् इति । स मुद्राय त्वा वाताय स्वाहेति जुहोति । यथायजुर् यज् जुहुयाद् रुद्राय पशून् अपिदध्याद् अपशुस् स्याद् । यजुर् एव वदेद् । रुद्राद् एव पशून् परिवृणक्ति । सर्वा वा एतर्ह्य् एतस्मिन् देवता आशंसन्ते मह्यं होष्यति मह्यं होष्यतीति । देवता एवैनम् अभिध्यायन्तीस् ता एनम् अभागा ईश्वरा हिंस्तोर् ।
2.m: If he were to offer according to the yajus, he would consign the cattle to Rudra; he would become bereft of cattle. He should only speak the yajus; thus he spares the cattle from Rudra. At that moment all the deities hope regarding him: “He will offer to me! He will offer to me!” The deities meditating upon him, being shareless, would be capable of harming him. When he says, “To Agni accompanied by the Vasus, svāhā!” he makes the deities share-holders, for the non-injury of himself. Some deities share in the yajus, others share in the oblation; he gratifies both of them. [With the words,] “Place this sacrifice in heaven! Place this sacrifice in heaven!”—these worlds and quarters desired a share in the Gharma. When he says, “Place in heaven! Go to heaven! Go to the intermediate space! Go to the earth! Go to the five directions!” he gratifies these worlds and the directions in the Gharma. [With the words,] “Go to the gods who drink the Gharma!”—those gods who are drinkers of the Gharma, them he thus gratifies in the Gharma. With [the words], “To the gods who drink the Gharma, svāhā!” he offers into the Mahāvīra with the supporting ladle; those gods who are drinkers of the Gharma, them he gratifies in the Gharma. The gods and the asuras did equally in the Pravargya; whatever the gods did, that the asuras did. The asuras performed the Pravargya silently; it burned them up. The gods performed the Pravargya loudly; the gods flourished, the asuras perished. […] the second ones. Thus it is offered for himself, it becomes accompanied by the vaṣaṭ-call. [With the words,] “O Aśvins, you have drunk the Gharma,” [it is said by] the sacrificer; thereby he asks of their satisfaction. Moreover, it becomes accompanied by the vaṣaṭ-call. With [the words], “Sitting in the south across all quarters,” the brahman priest recites over what has been offered. Thus it is offered for himself. [With the words,] “Swell for food! Swell for nourishment!” he places food and nourishment right into the sacrifice. With [the words], “Swell for this priesthood! Swell for this nobility! Swell for this commonality!” he makes the priesthood, the nobility, and the commonality share-holders. [With the words,] “Swell for this pressing sacrificer!”

2.s: yad āhāgnaye tvā vasumate svāheti devatā eva bhāganīḥ karoty ātmano 'hiṃsāyai | yajurbhājo 'nye devatā āhitibhājo 'nye | tān evobhayān prīṇāti |
2.d: यद् आहाग्नये त्वा वसुमते स्वाहेति देवता एव भागनीः करोत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै । यजुर्भाजो ऽन्ये देवता आहितिभाजो ऽन्ये । तान् एवोभयान् प्रीणाति ।

2.s: divi dhā imaṃ yajñam imaṃ yajñaṃ divi dhā itīme vai lokā diśaś ca gharme 'pitvam aiśchanta |
2.d: दिवि धा इमं यज्ञम् इमं यज्ञं दिवि धा इतीमे वै लोका दिशश् च घर्मे ऽपित्वम् ऐश्छन्त ।

2.s: yad āha divi dhā divaṃ gaśchāṇtarikṣaṃ gaścha pṛthivīṃ gaścha pañca pradiśo gaśchetīmān eva lokān diśaś ca gharme tarpayati |
2.d: यद् आह दिवि धा दिवं गश्छाण्तरिक्षं गश्छ पृथिवीं गश्छ पञ्च प्रदिशो गश्छेतीमान् एव लोकान् दिशश् च घर्मे तर्पयति ।

2.s: devān gharmāpān gaścheti | ya eva devā gharmapās tān evaṃ tad gharme tarpayati |
2.d: देवान् घर्मापान् गश्छेति । य एव देवा घर्मपास् तान् एवं तद् घर्मे तर्पयति ।

2.s: devebhyas tvā gharmapebhyas svāhety upayāmena mahāvīre juhoti | ya eva devā gharmapās tān eva tad gharme tarpayati | devāś ca vā asurāś ca samāvad eva pravargye 'kurvata | yad eva devā akurvata tad asurā akurvata | te 'surā upāṃśu pravargyeṇācaran | sa enān niradahad | uccair devāḥ pravargyeṇācaran | te devā abhavan te 'surāḥ parābhavan | g hav rā dvitīyān | tad evāsyātmane hutaṃ | vaṣaṭkṛtam bhavati |
2.d: देवेभ्यस् त्वा घर्मपेभ्यस् स्वाहेत्य् उपयामेन महावीरे जुहोति । य एव देवा घर्मपास् तान् एव तद् घर्मे तर्पयति । देवाश् च वा असुराश् च समावद् एव प्रवर्ग्ये ऽकुर्वत । यद् एव देवा अकुर्वत तद् असुरा अकुर्वत । ते ऽसुरा उपांशु प्रवर्ग्येणाचरन् । स एनान् निरदहद् । उच्चैर् देवाः प्रवर्ग्येणाचरन् । ते देवा अभवन् ते ऽसुराः पराभवन् । ग् हव् रा द्वितीयान् । तद् एवास्यात्मने हुतं । वषट्कृतम् भवति ।

2.s: gharmam apātam aśvineti yajamānas | tṛptim eva tat pṛśchaty | atho vaṣaṭkṛtam bhavati |
2.d: घर्मम् अपातम् अश्विनेति यजमानस् । तृप्तिम् एव तत् पृश्छत्य् । अथो वषट्कृतम् भवति ।

2.s: viśvā āśā dakṣiṇāsad iti brahmā hutam anumantrayate | tad evāsyātmane hutam bhaviti
2.d: विश्वा आशा दक्षिणासद् इति ब्रह्मा हुतम् अनुमन्त्रयते । तद् एवास्यात्मने हुतम् भविति

2.s: iṣe pinvasvorje pinvasvetīṣam evorjaṃ yajñe dadhāty | asmai brahmaṇe pinvasvāmai kṣatrāya pinvasvāsyai viśe pinvasveti brahmakṣatre viśaṃ caiva bhāginaḥ karoty |
2.d: इषे पिन्वस्वोर्जे पिन्वस्वेतीषम् एवोर्जं यज्ञे दधात्य् । अस्मै ब्रह्मणे पिन्वस्वामै क्षत्राय पिन्वस्वास्यै विशे पिन्वस्वेति ब्रह्मक्षत्रे विशं चैव भागिनः करोत्य् ।

2.s: asmai sunvate yajamānāya pinvasveti | yajamānāyaivaitām āśiṣam āśāste |
2.d: अस्मै सुन्वते यजमानाय पिन्वस्वेति । यजमानायैवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते ।
2.m: He prays for this blessing for the sacrificer himself. With [the mantra] 'Swell for welfare', he attains welfare. With 'Swell for priestly splendor', he becomes endowed with priestly splendor. With 'Swell for my life, luster, primacy, increase of wealth, and good offspring', he prays for this blessing for himself. With 'For brilliance thee, for glory thee, for welfare thee, for virile power thee', he extends the vessel clockwise. He makes the quarters sharers [of the offering], for the non-injury of himself. 'Thou art the maintainer, a good maintainer; uphold these prayers for him.' This [Rudra] is indeed Agni. Just as one cuts a share for Agni, just so is this. With 'Bhūḥ, bhuvaḥ, svaḥ, an offered oblation, honey oblation to the most Indra-like fire, svāhā', he offers following the rule of the Agnihotra. This is indeed the completion, fashioned like heaven. And, for non-interruption, he offers mentally with a [mantra] to Prajāpati. Prajāpati is indeed like the mind; the sacrifice belongs to Prajāpati; he extends the sacrifice itself. They deliberate: 'Is it to be consumed, or is it not to be consumed?' If he were to consume it, he would be liable to perish; if he were not to consume it, it would become non-oblation. He should smell it; he thereby does both. The sacrificer alone consumes it; he places priestly splendor in himself. He says, 'Recite for [the Gharma] being placed down', for support. With 'Thee for the day, thee for the sun, thee for the night, thee for the constellations', he makes the day and night and the sun and constellations sharers. The Brāhmaṇa mantras of the 'Yuñjate' are completed. The Gharmājaṭharā Brāhmaṇa: 'O Gharmājaṭharau, make me a consumer of food among these people; may I be a consumer of food among these people.' Indra and Agni are indeed the two Gharmājaṭharas among the gods. They rule over proper food. They grant proper food to him. He who knows thus becomes an eater of food. 'O Kavī-Mātariśvānau, make me prosperous among these people; may I be prosperous among these people.' […] are indeed the two Kavī-Mātariśvans among the gods. They rule over prosperity. They grant prosperity to him.

2.s: subhūtāya pinvasveti | bhūtim evopaiti |
2.d: सुभूताय पिन्वस्वेति । भूतिम् एवोपैति ।

2.s: brahmavarcasāya pinvasveti | brahmavarcasī bhavati |
2.d: ब्रह्मवर्चसाय पिन्वस्वेति । ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति ।

2.s: mahyam āyuṣe varcase jyaiṣṭhyāya rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya pinvasvety | ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste |
2.d: मह्यम् आयुषे वर्चसे ज्यैष्ठ्याय रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय पिन्वस्वेत्य् । आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते ।

2.s: tviṣyai tvā dyumnāya tvā bhūtyai tvendriyāya tveti pradakṣiṇam pātram praśrayati | diśa eva bhāginīḥ karoty ātmano 'himsāyai |
2.d: त्विष्यै त्वा द्युम्नाय त्वा भूत्यै त्वेन्द्रियाय त्वेति प्रदक्षिणम् पात्रम् प्रश्रयति । दिश एव भागिनीः करोत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिम्सायै ।

2.s: dharmāsi sudharmemāny asmai brahmāṇi dhārayeti | rudro vā eṣa yad agnir | yathāgnaye samavadyaty evam evaitad |
2.d: धर्मासि सुधर्मेमान्य् अस्मै ब्रह्माणि धारयेति । रुद्रो वा एष यद् अग्निर् । यथाग्नये समवद्यत्य् एवम् एवैतद् ।

2.s: bhūr bhuvas svar hutaṃ havir madhu havir indratame 'gnau svāhety agnihotravidhiṃ juhoti | saṃsthitir evaiṣā svargākṛtir | atho anantarhityai manasā prājāpatyā juhoti | mana iva vai prajāpatiḥ | prājāpatyo yajño | yajñam eva santanoti | prāśyā3 na prāśyā3 iti mīmāṃsante | yat prāśnīyāt prākārukas syād yan na prāśnīyād ahavis syād | avajighred | ubhayam eva karoti | yajamāna eva prāśnāti | brahmavarcasam evātman dhatte |
2.d: भूर् भुवस् स्वर् हुतं हविर् मधु हविर् इन्द्रतमे ऽग्नौ स्वाहेत्य् अग्निहोत्रविधिं जुहोति । संस्थितिर् एवैषा स्वर्गाकृतिर् । अथो अनन्तर्हित्यै मनसा प्राजापत्या जुहोति । मन इव वै प्रजापतिः । प्राजापत्यो यज्ञो । यज्ञम् एव सन्तनोति । प्राश्या3 न प्राश्या3 इति मीमांसन्ते । यत् प्राश्नीयात् प्राकारुकस् स्याद् यन् न प्राश्नीयाद् अहविस् स्याद् । अवजिघ्रेद् । उभयम् एव करोति । यजमान एव प्राश्नाति । ब्रह्मवर्चसम् एवात्मन् धत्ते ।

2.s: saṃsādyamānāyānubrūhīty āha pratiṣṭhāyā |
2.d: संसाद्यमानायानुब्रूहीत्य् आह प्रतिष्ठाया ।

2.s: ahne tvā sūryāya tvā rātryai tvā nakṣatrebhyas tvety ahorātre sūryanakṣatrāṇi caiva bhāginaḥ karoti | yuñjatebrāhmaṇamantrā samāptā |
2.d: अह्ने त्वा सूर्याय त्वा रात्र्यै त्वा नक्षत्रेभ्यस् त्वेत्य् अहोरात्रे सूर्यनक्षत्राणि चैव भागिनः करोति । युञ्जतेब्राह्मणमन्त्रा समाप्ता ।

3.s: gharmājaṭharānnādam māsmiñ jane kurutam annnādo 'ham asmiñ jane bhūyāsam itīndrāgnī vai devānāṃ gharmājaṭharau | tā annādyasyeśāte | tā asmā annādyam prayaśchato | 'nnādo bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: घर्माजठरान्नादम् मास्मिञ् जने कुरुतम् अन्न्नादो ऽहम् अस्मिञ् जने भूयासम् इतीन्द्राग्नी वै देवानां घर्माजठरौ । ता अन्नाद्यस्येशाते । ता अस्मा अन्नाद्यम् प्रयश्छतो । ऽन्नादो भवति य एवं वेद ।

3.s: kavīmātariśvānā puṣṭivantaṃ māsmiñ jane kurutam puṣṭivān aham asmiñ jane bhūyāsam iti | vai devānāṃ kavīmātariśvānau | tau puṣṭer īśāte | tā asmai puṣṭim prayaśchataḥ | puṣṭivān bhavati ya evaṃ veda arkāsadhasthā cakṣuṣmantam māsmiñ jane kurutam cakṣuṣmān aham asmiñ jane bhūyāsam iti | mitrāvaruṇā vai devānām arkāsadhasthā | tau cakṣuṣa īśāte | tā asmai cakṣuḥ prayaśchataś | cakṣuṣmān bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: कवीमातरिश्वाना पुष्टिवन्तं मास्मिञ् जने कुरुतम् पुष्टिवान् अहम् अस्मिञ् जने भूयासम् इति । वै देवानां कवीमातरिश्वानौ । तौ पुष्टेर् ईशाते । ता अस्मै पुष्टिम् प्रयश्छतः । पुष्टिवान् भवति य एवं वेद अर्कासधस्था चक्षुष्मन्तम् मास्मिञ् जने कुरुतम् चक्षुष्मान् अहम् अस्मिञ् जने भूयासम् इति । मित्रावरुणा वै देवानाम् अर्कासधस्था । तौ चक्षुष ईशाते । ता अस्मै चक्षुः प्रयश्छतश् । चक्षुष्मान् भवति य एवं वेद ।
3.m: He who knows thus becomes prosperous. 'O Arkāsadhasthau, make me endowed with sight among these people; may I be endowed with sight among these people.' Mitra and Varuṇa are indeed the two Arkāsadhasthas among the gods. They rule over sight. They grant sight to him. He who knows thus becomes endowed with sight. 'O father and mother, make me endowed with hearing among these people; may I be endowed with hearing among these people.' Heaven and Earth are indeed the father and mother among the gods. They rule over hearing. They grant hearing to him. He who knows thus becomes endowed with hearing. 'O Yama and Aṅgiras, make me long-lived among these people; may I be long-lived among these people.' Yama and Varuṇa are indeed the Yama and Aṅgiras among the gods. They rule over lifespan. They grant lifespan to him. He who knows thus becomes long-lived. With 'May we partake of thee, Gharma, full of honey, full of nourishment; homage be to thee; do not injure me', [he prays] for non-injury to himself. With 'Thou art light, the sap of trees', he fills it first with honey. Honey is indeed this sap of the flowers and fruits of trees. With that alone he completes it. Then they say, 'Honey is life; if one were to place life into the fire, he would be liable to die.' When he says, 'Place life in me', he places life into himself; he becomes long-lived. With 'Thou art light-radiant, the sap of waters and plants', he [fills] it second with ghee; this is indeed its dear abode; with that he completes it. When he says, 'Place sight in me', he places sight into himself; he becomes endowed with sight. With […] the third with curd; this is indeed its dear abode; with that he completes it. When he says, 'Place nourishment in me', he places nourishment into himself; he becomes full of nourishment. With 'And fierce and shaking', the group [of mantras] to be recited in the forest is for pacification. With 'O Agni, lord of vows! O Vāyu, lord of vows! O Sūrya, lord of vows!', these indeed are the lords of vows among the gods.

3.s: pitarāmātarā śrotravantaṃ māsmiñ jane kurutaṃ śrotravān aham asmiñ jane bhūyāsam iti | dyāvāpṛthivī vai devānāṃ pitarāmātarau tau śrotrasyeśāte | tā asmai śrotraṃ prayaśchatas | śrotravān bhavati ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: पितरामातरा श्रोत्रवन्तं मास्मिञ् जने कुरुतं श्रोत्रवान् अहम् अस्मिञ् जने भूयासम् इति । द्यावापृथिवी वै देवानां पितरामातरौ तौ श्रोत्रस्येशाते । ता अस्मै श्रोत्रं प्रयश्छतस् । श्रोत्रवान् भवति य एवं वेद ।

3.s: yamāṅgirasā āyuṣmantaṃ māsmiñ jane kurutam āyuṣmān aham asmiñ jane bhūyāsam iti | yamaś caiva varuṇaś ca devānāṃ yamāṅgirasau | tā āyuṣa īśāte | tā asmā āyuḥ prayaśchata | āyuṣmān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
3.d: यमाङ्गिरसा आयुष्मन्तं मास्मिञ् जने कुरुतम् आयुष्मान् अहम् अस्मिञ् जने भूयासम् इति । यमश् चैव वरुणश् च देवानां यमाङ्गिरसौ । ता आयुष ईशाते । ता अस्मा आयुः प्रयश्छत । आयुष्मान् भवति य एवं वेद

3.s: aśyāma te gharma madhumataḥ pitumato namas te astu mā mā hiṃsīr ity ātmano 'hiṃsāyai |
3.d: अश्याम ते घर्म मधुमतः पितुमतो नमस् ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीर् इत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै ।

3.s: jyotir asi vanaspatīnāṃ rasa iti madhunā prathamam pūrayati | vanaspatīnāṃ vā eṣa puṣpaphalānām raso yan madhu | tenaivainaṃ samardhayati | tad āhāyur vai madhv | āyur agnau pradadhyāt pramāyukas syād iti |
3.d: ज्योतिर् असि वनस्पतीनां रस इति मधुना प्रथमम् पूरयति । वनस्पतीनां वा एष पुष्पफलानाम् रसो यन् मधु । तेनैवैनं समर्धयति । तद् आहायुर् वै मध्व् । आयुर् अग्नौ प्रदध्यात् प्रमायुकस् स्याद् इति ।

3.s: yad āhāyur mayi dhehīty āyur evātman dhatta āyuṣmān bhavati |
3.d: यद् आहायुर् मयि धेहीत्य् आयुर् एवात्मन् धत्त आयुष्मान् भवति ।

3.s: jyotir bhā asy apām oṣadhīnāṃ rasa iti ghṛtena dvitīyam etad vā etasya priyaṃ dhāma | tenaivainaṃ samardhayati | yad āha cakṣur mayi dhehīti cakṣur evātman dhatte cakṣuṣmān bhavati | iti dadhnā tṛtīyam | etad vā etasya priyaṃ dhāma tenaivainaṃ samardhayati | yad āhorjam mayi dhehīty ūrjam evātman dhatta | ūrjasvān bhavaty |
3.d: ज्योतिर् भा अस्य् अपाम् ओषधीनां रस इति घृतेन द्वितीयम् एतद् वा एतस्य प्रियं धाम । तेनैवैनं समर्धयति । यद् आह चक्षुर् मयि धेहीति चक्षुर् एवात्मन् धत्ते चक्षुष्मान् भवति । इति दध्ना तृतीयम् । एतद् वा एतस्य प्रियं धाम तेनैवैनं समर्धयति । यद् आहोर्जम् मयि धेहीत्य् ऊर्जम् एवात्मन् धत्त । ऊर्जस्वान् भवत्य् ।

3.s: ugraś ca dhuniś cety araṇye 'nuvākyo gaṇaś śāntyā |
3.d: उग्रश् च धुनिश् चेत्य् अरण्ये ऽनुवाक्यो गणश् शान्त्या ।

3.s: agne vratapate vāyo vratapate sūrya vratapata ity | ete vai devānāṃ vratapatayas | tebhya eva procyāvāntaradīkṣām upaiti |
3.d: अग्ने व्रतपते वायो व्रतपते सूर्य व्रतपत इत्य् । एते वै देवानां व्रतपतयस् । तेभ्य एव प्रोच्यावान्तरदीक्षाम् उपैति ।
3.m: Having announced it to them, he enters upon the intermediate consecration. With 'Earth is the kindling wood', [it is done] according to the yajus. With 'May the day delight with the banner, the good light of lights, svāhā', he offers the Rauhiṇa cake offering. That sun is indeed the banner of the days. With 'May the night delight with the banner, the good light of lights, svāhā', he offers the Rauhiṇa cake offering. The moon is indeed the banner of the nights. The two eyes of the Pravargya are indeed the sun and moon. The two Rauhiṇa offerings are the two eyes; he places sight in the two eyes. With 'Homage to Rudra who dwells in heaven, whose arrows are rain', he injures creatures having made rain into arrows when it rains fiercely. With 'Homage to him', he makes the rain auspicious. With 'Do not encounter me with that', he says this: 'May we not meet in conflict.' With 'Homage to Rudra who dwells in the atmosphere, whose arrows are the wind', he injures creatures having made the wind into arrows when it blows fiercely. With 'Homage to him', he makes the wind auspicious. With 'Do not encounter me with that', he says this: 'May we not meet in conflict.' With 'Homage to Rudra who dwells on the earth, whose arrows are food', he injures creatures having made food into arrows when fiercely […]. With 'Homage to him', he makes food auspicious. With 'Do not encounter me with that', he says this: 'May we not meet in conflict.' […] the ṛcs, the yajuses, the sāmans […] with praises alone he praises him. When [he says], 'That thou, O Brahman, may hear abundantly', he places priestly splendor in himself. Therefore, an unlearned priest should not perform the Pravargya; he indeed is not one who has heard the Veda at that time. With 'May we be the most favored here of thee', he makes him a sharer of the Vedas. Therefore they say: 'The adhvaryu knows the rite; the adhvaryu becomes the leader of the others.' With 'The great tawny bull roared, like kindly Mitra of fair aspect', if he, having become Varuṇa, were to scorch creatures, he would not leave anyone remaining; having become Mitra alone, he warms creatures. With 'Flashing together with the sun'—

3.s: pṛthivī samid iti yathāyajuḥ |
3.d: पृथिवी समिद् इति यथायजुः ।

3.s: ahaḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotir jyotiṣām svāheti rauhiṇaṃ juhoty | asau vā ādityo 'hnāṃ ketū |
3.d: अहः केतुना जुषतां सुज्योतिर् ज्योतिषाम् स्वाहेति रौहिणं जुहोत्य् । असौ वा आदित्यो ऽह्नां केतू ।

3.s: rātrī ketunā juṣatām sujyotir jyotiṣāṃ svāheti rauhiṇaṃ juhoti | candramā vai rātrīṇāṃ ketuś | cakṣuṣī vā ete pravargyasya yat sūryācandramasau | cakṣuṣī rauhiṇau cakṣuṣor eva cakṣur dadhāti |
3.d: रात्री केतुना जुषताम् सुज्योतिर् ज्योतिषां स्वाहेति रौहिणं जुहोति । चन्द्रमा वै रात्रीणां केतुश् । चक्षुषी वा एते प्रवर्ग्यस्य यत् सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ । चक्षुषी रौहिणौ चक्षुषोर् एव चक्षुर् दधाति ।

3.s: namo rudrāya diviṣade yasya varṣam iṣava iti | varṣaṃ vā eṣa iśūḥ kṛtvā prajā hinasti yadograṃ varṣati |
3.d: नमो रुद्राय दिविषदे यस्य वर्षम् इषव इति । वर्षं वा एष इशूः कृत्वा प्रजा हिनस्ति यदोग्रं वर्षति ।

3.s: tasmai nama iti varṣam eva śivaṃ karoti |
3.d: तस्मै नम इति वर्षम् एव शिवं करोति ।

3.s: tena mā samara iti mā sambādhe samāgamāmety evaitad āha |
3.d: तेन मा समर इति मा सम्बाधे समागमामेत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

3.s: namo rudrāyāntarikṣasade yasya vāta iṣava iti | vātaṃ vā eṣa iṣūḥ kṛtvā prajā hinasti yadograṃ vāti |
3.d: नमो रुद्रायान्तरिक्षसदे यस्य वात इषव इति । वातं वा एष इषूः कृत्वा प्रजा हिनस्ति यदोग्रं वाति ।

3.s: tasmai nama iti vātam eva śivaṅ karoti |
3.d: तस्मै नम इति वातम् एव शिवङ् करोति ।

3.s: tena mā samara iti mā sambādhe samāgamāmety evaitad āha |
3.d: तेन मा समर इति मा सम्बाधे समागमामेत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

3.s: namo rudrāya pṛthivīṣade yasyānnam iṣava ity annaṃ vā eṣa iṣūḥ kṛtvā prajā hinasti yadogram | tasmai nama iti annam eva śivaṅ karoti | tena mā samara iti mā sambādhe samāgamāmety evaitad āha | ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni stutibhir evainaṃ stauti |
3.d: नमो रुद्राय पृथिवीषदे यस्यान्नम् इषव इत्य् अन्नं वा एष इषूः कृत्वा प्रजा हिनस्ति यदोग्रम् । तस्मै नम इति अन्नम् एव शिवङ् करोति । तेन मा समर इति मा सम्बाधे समागमामेत्य् एवैतद् आह । ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि स्तुतिभिर् एवैनं स्तौति ।

3.s: yad brahmaṇaś śṛṇavo bhūr iti brahmavarcasam evātman dhatte | tasmān nāśrotriya pravṛñjyān | na vā eṣa tarhi śrutabrahmā bhavaty |
3.d: यद् ब्रह्मणश् शृणवो भूर् इति ब्रह्मवर्चसम् एवात्मन् धत्ते । तस्मान् नाश्रोत्रिय प्रवृञ्ज्यान् । न वा एष तर्हि श्रुतब्रह्मा भवत्य् ।

3.s: atra bhūyiṣṭhabhāja iha te syāmeti | vedānām evainaṃ bhāginaṃ karoti | tasmād āhur adhvaryur vā adhvaraṃ vedādhvaryur anyeṣām agraṇīr bhavaty |
3.d: अत्र भूयिष्ठभाज इह ते स्यामेति । वेदानाम् एवैनं भागिनं करोति । तस्माद् आहुर् अध्वर्युर् वा अध्वरं वेदाध्वर्युर् अन्येषाम् अग्रणीर् भवत्य् ।

3.s: acikradad vṛṣā harir mahān mitro na darśata iti | yad vā eṣa varuṇo bhūtvā prajā abhitapen na kañcanāvaśiṃsyān | mitra eva bhūtvā prajā abhitapati |
3.d: अचिक्रदद् वृषा हरिर् महान् मित्रो न दर्शत इति । यद् वा एष वरुणो भूत्वा प्रजा अभितपेन् न कञ्चनावशिंस्यान् । मित्र एव भूत्वा प्रजा अभितपति ।

3.s: saṃ sūryeṇa didyutad iti | sūryasyeva vā eṣa etasya prakāśo bhavati yasyaiṣa pravṛjyate | sarvā vā etarhy etasmin devatā adhvaryor dadhigharma āśaṃsante mahyaṃ grahīṣyati mahyaṅ grahīṣyatīti | devatā evainam abhidhyāyantīs tā enam abhāgā īśvarā hiṃstor |
3.d: सं सूर्येण दिद्युतद् इति । सूर्यस्येव वा एष एतस्य प्रकाशो भवति यस्यैष प्रवृज्यते । सर्वा वा एतर्ह्य् एतस्मिन् देवता अध्वर्योर् दधिघर्म आशंसन्ते मह्यं ग्रहीष्यति मह्यङ् ग्रहीष्यतीति । देवता एवैनम् अभिध्यायन्तीस् ता एनम् अभागा ईश्वरा हिंस्तोर् ।
3.m: Like the sun, indeed, is his brilliance, for whom this [Pravargya] is performed. At that time, all the deities look forward to the adhvaryu’s curd-gharma: ‘He will draw for me, he will draw for me!’ The deities yearn for him; [if left] without a share, they would be capable of harming him. When he draws with these two [formulas] containing all deities, ‘Whom Indra...’ and ‘As many as...’, he makes the deities share-holders for the non-injury of himself. He who knows thus attains the full lifespan. He offers five oblations with: ‘To Puṣan, the glowing, hail!’ Puṣan is Rudra; Rudra is glowing. These indeed are the fierce names of Rudra. When about to perform the udvāsana, he buys him off from all the deities. He who knows thus attains the full lifespan. ‘O Gharma, what heat of yours is in heaven, what in the Jagatī meter, what in the seventeenfold stoma, what in the havirdhāna shed, that of yours I appease with this: to it, hail!’ Thus he buys Rudra off from that [world], from the Jagatī meter, from the seventeenfold stoma, and from the havirdhāna shed. He who knows thus attains the full lifespan. ‘O Gharma, what heat of yours is in the intermediate space, what in the Triṣṭubh meter, what in the fifteenfold stoma, what in the fire-kindler's shed, that of yours I appease with this: to it, hail!’ Thus he buys Rudra off from the intermediate space, from the Triṣṭubh meter, from the fifteenfold stoma, and from the fire-kindler's shed. He who knows thus attains the full lifespan. ‘O Gharma, what heat of yours is on earth, what in the Gāyatrī meter, what in the ninefold stoma, what in the sadas shed, that of yours I appease with this: to it, hail!’ Thus he buys Rudra off from this [earth], from the Gāyatrī meter, from the ninefold stoma, and from the sadas shed. He who knows thus attains the full lifespan. He offers when it is set down, with: ‘Favor us today, O Anumati!’ This [earth] is Anumati; this [earth] is the firm foundation; thus he stands firmly on it. First he fills it with honey. That indeed is his dear abode; he prospers him with that very thing. [...] they lead him upward toward the east.

3.s: yad etābhyāṃ sarvadevatyābhyāṃ gṛhṇāti yam indraṃ yāvatīti devatā eva bhāginīḥ karoty ātmano 'hiṃsāyai | sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: यद् एताभ्यां सर्वदेवत्याभ्यां गृह्णाति यम् इन्द्रं यावतीति देवता एव भागिनीः करोत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद ।

3.s: pūṣṇa āghṛṇaye svāheti pañcāhutīr juhoti | pūṣā vai rudro rudra āghṛṇir | etāni vai rudrasya ugrāṇi nāmāni | udvāsanaṅ kariṣyan sarvābhyo devatābhya eva niravadayate | sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: पूष्ण आघृणये स्वाहेति पञ्चाहुतीर् जुहोति । पूषा वै रुद्रो रुद्र आघृणिर् । एतानि वै रुद्रस्य उग्राणि नामानि । उद्वासनङ् करिष्यन् सर्वाभ्यो देवताभ्य एव निरवदयते । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद ।

3.s: yā te gharma divi śug yā jāgate śchandasi yā saptadaśe stome yā havirdhāne tān ta etad avayaje tasyai svāhety | amuṣyā evainam etaj jāgatāc chandasas saptadaśāt stomād dhavirdhānāc ca rudraṃ niravadayate | sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: या ते घर्म दिवि शुग् या जागते श्छन्दसि या सप्तदशे स्तोमे या हविर्धाने तान् त एतद् अवयजे तस्यै स्वाहेत्य् । अमुष्या एवैनम् एतज् जागताच् छन्दसस् सप्तदशात् स्तोमाद् धविर्धानाच् च रुद्रं निरवदयते । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद ।

3.s: yā te gharmāntarikṣe śug yā traiṣṭubhe śchandasi yā pañcadaśe stome yāgnīdhre tān ta etad avayaje tasyai svāhety | antarikṣād evainam etat traiṣṭubhāc chandasaḥ pañcadaśāt stomād āgnīdhrāc ca rudraṃ niravadayate | sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda |
3.d: या ते घर्मान्तरिक्षे शुग् या त्रैष्टुभे श्छन्दसि या पञ्चदशे स्तोमे याग्नीध्रे तान् त एतद् अवयजे तस्यै स्वाहेत्य् । अन्तरिक्षाद् एवैनम् एतत् त्रैष्टुभाच् छन्दसः पञ्चदशात् स्तोमाद् आग्नीध्राच् च रुद्रं निरवदयते । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद ।

3.s: yā te gharma pṛthivyāṃ śug yā gāyatre śchandasi yā trivṛti stome yā sadasi tān ta etenāvyaje tasyai svāhety | asyā evainam etad gāyatrāc chandasas trivṛtas stomāt sadasas ca rudraṃ niravadayate | sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda
3.d: या ते घर्म पृथिव्यां शुग् या गायत्रे श्छन्दसि या त्रिवृति स्तोमे या सदसि तान् त एतेनाव्यजे तस्यै स्वाहेत्य् । अस्या एवैनम् एतद् गायत्राच् छन्दसस् त्रिवृतस् स्तोमात् सदसस् च रुद्रं निरवदयते । सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद

3.s: anv adya no anumata iti pratiṣṭhite juhotīyaṃ vā anumatir iyaṃ pratiṣṭhāsyām evaṃ pratitiṣthati | madhunā prathamam pūrayaty | etad vā etasya priyaṃ dhāma | tenaivainaṃ samardhayati | ta iti prāñcam adhyudānayanty | eṣa vai devaloko devalokam evainam abhyudānayanti | patnīm udānayanty asthūritvāya vāsasā patnīṃ praśchādayati | sarvadevatyaṃ vai vāsas | sarvābhir evaināṃ devatābhis samardhayati | sāma sampreṣyaty | upagāyanam evāsyaitad |
3.d: अन्व् अद्य नो अनुमत इति प्रतिष्ठिते जुहोतीयं वा अनुमतिर् इयं प्रतिष्ठास्याम् एवं प्रतितिष्थति । मधुना प्रथमम् पूरयत्य् । एतद् वा एतस्य प्रियं धाम । तेनैवैनं समर्धयति । त इति प्राञ्चम् अध्युदानयन्त्य् । एष वै देवलोको देवलोकम् एवैनम् अभ्युदानयन्ति । पत्नीम् उदानयन्त्य् अस्थूरित्वाय वाससा पत्नीं प्रश्छादयति । सर्वदेवत्यं वै वासस् । सर्वाभिर् एवैनां देवताभिस् समर्धयति । साम सम्प्रेष्यत्य् । उपगायनम् एवास्यैतद् ।
3.m: This indeed is the world of the gods; it is toward the world of the gods that they lead him upward. They lead up the wife for the sake of completeness. He covers the wife with a garment. The garment belongs to all the deities; he prospers her with all the deities. He summons for the chant. That is his accompanying singing. Then they indeed make amends to him; they advance forward: ‘Protecting you beyond heaven, protect the body of the intermediate space! By the law of earth we follow you for newer well-being.’ In saying this, he says: ‘Do not injure these worlds!’ ‘Protect my out-breath!’ He prays for this blessing for himself. Halfway, they approach a second time and advance forward: ‘Protecting you beyond the priesthood, protect the body of nobility! By the law of the people we follow you for newer well-being.’ In saying this, he says: ‘Do not injure the offspring!’ ‘Protect my through-breath!’ He prays for this blessing for himself. Having arrived, they approach a third time and advance forward: ‘Protecting you beyond breath, protect the body of sight! By the law of hearing we follow you for newer well-being.’ In saying this, he says: ‘Do not injure the vital breaths!’ ‘Protect my in-breath!’ He prays for this blessing for himself. [...] There are bundles of grass; he thereby makes the hair. The potsherds are on both sides; he thereby makes the skull-bones. He places two gold plates on both sides; he thereby makes the two eyes. He places the caru pot behind; he thereby makes the mouth. He places the ladle behind; he thereby makes the neck. He places the two tongs on both sides; he thereby makes the shoulders. He makes the two spoons the arms. To give it a body, the two fans are on both sides; he thereby makes the flanks. In the middle is the receptacle, and there are cords and bamboo items; he thereby makes the belly. Behind he places the two lip-shaped vessels; he thereby makes the lap. On both sides are the peg-stakes; he thereby makes the shanks and thighs. On both sides he places the two fire-shovels; he thereby makes the feet.

3.s: atho ny evāsmai hnuvate 'bhiprayānti divas tvā paraspām antarikṣasya tanvam pāhi pṛthivyās tvā dharmaṇā vayam anukrāmāma suvitāya navyasa itīmāṃ llokān mā hiṃsīr ity evaitad āha |
3.d: अथो न्य् एवास्मै ह्नुवते ऽभिप्रयान्ति दिवस् त्वा परस्पाम् अन्तरिक्षस्य तन्वम् पाहि पृथिव्यास् त्वा धर्मणा वयम् अनुक्रामाम सुविताय नव्यस इतीमां ल्लोकान् मा हिंसीर् इत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

3.s: prāṇam me pāhīty | ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste | vyadhve dvitīyam upayanty abhiprayānti |
3.d: प्राणम् मे पाहीत्य् । आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते । व्यध्वे द्वितीयम् उपयन्त्य् अभिप्रयान्ति ।

3.s: brahmaṇas tvā paraspāṃ kṣatrasya tanvaṃ pāhi viśas tvā dharmaṇā vayam anukrāmāma suvitāya navyasa iti | prajām mā hiṃsīr ity evaitad āha |
3.d: ब्रह्मणस् त्वा परस्पां क्षत्रस्य तन्वं पाहि विशस् त्वा धर्मणा वयम् अनुक्रामाम सुविताय नव्यस इति । प्रजाम् मा हिंसीर् इत्य् एवैतद् आह ।

3.s: vyānam me pāhīty | ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāsta |
3.d: व्यानम् मे पाहीत्य् । आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्त ।

3.s: upaprāpya tṛtīyam upayanty abhiprayānti prāṇasya tvā paraspāṃ cakṣuṣas tanvam pāhi śrotrasya tvā dharmaṇā vayam anukrāmāma suvitāya navyasa iti | prāṇān mā hiṃsīr ity evaitad āha apānam me pāhīty | ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāste | vedā bhavanti | keśān evainān tat karoty | abhitaḥ kapālāni | kapālāny eva tat karoty | abhito rukmau nidadhāty | cakṣuṣī eva tat karoti | paścāc caruṣṭhālī nidadhāty | āsyam eva tat karoti | paścāt sruvaṃ nidadhāty | grīvām eva tat karoty | abhitaś śaphau nidadhāty | aṃsā eva tat karoti | srucau bāhū karoti | sātmatvāyābhito dhavitre bhavataḥ | pārśve eva tat karoti | madhya upayāmo rajjvoś ca vaiṇavāni bhavanty | udaram eva tat karoti | paścād auṣṭhyau nidadhāty | upastham eva tat karoty | abhito mayūkhā bhavanti | jaṅghe ūrū eva tat karoty | abhito dhṛṣṭī nidadhāti | pādā eva tat karoti | madhye dhavitram nidadhāti | nābhim eva tat karoty | upary āsandīm nidadhāty | ura eva tat karoti | kṛṣṇājinena praśchādayati | brahmaṇo vā etad rūpam yat kṛṣṇājinaṃ | brahmaṇaivainam praśchādayati | muñjaiḥ praśchādayaty | ūrg vai muñjā ūrjaivainaṃ praśchādayati | dadhnā saṃsṛjati satejastvāyāghātuka enaṃ rudro bhavati | haṃsavat karoty | asau vā ādityo haṃsā e ḥ pariṣiñc
3.d: उपप्राप्य तृतीयम् उपयन्त्य् अभिप्रयान्ति प्राणस्य त्वा परस्पां चक्षुषस् तन्वम् पाहि श्रोत्रस्य त्वा धर्मणा वयम् अनुक्रामाम सुविताय नव्यस इति । प्राणान् मा हिंसीर् इत्य् एवैतद् आह अपानम् मे पाहीत्य् । आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्ते । वेदा भवन्ति । केशान् एवैनान् तत् करोत्य् । अभितः कपालानि । कपालान्य् एव तत् करोत्य् । अभितो रुक्मौ निदधात्य् । चक्षुषी एव तत् करोति । पश्चाच् चरुष्ठाली निदधात्य् । आस्यम् एव तत् करोति । पश्चात् स्रुवं निदधात्य् । ग्रीवाम् एव तत् करोत्य् । अभितश् शफौ निदधात्य् । अंसा एव तत् करोति । स्रुचौ बाहू करोति । सात्मत्वायाभितो धवित्रे भवतः । पार्श्वे एव तत् करोति । मध्य उपयामो रज्ज्वोश् च वैणवानि भवन्त्य् । उदरम् एव तत् करोति । पश्चाद् औष्ठ्यौ निदधात्य् । उपस्थम् एव तत् करोत्य् । अभितो मयूखा भवन्ति । जङ्घे ऊरू एव तत् करोत्य् । अभितो धृष्टी निदधाति । पादा एव तत् करोति । मध्ये धवित्रम् निदधाति । नाभिम् एव तत् करोत्य् । उपर्य् आसन्दीम् निदधात्य् । उर एव तत् करोति । कृष्णाजिनेन प्रश्छादयति । ब्रह्मणो वा एतद् रूपम् यत् कृष्णाजिनं । ब्रह्मणैवैनम् प्रश्छादयति । मुञ्जैः प्रश्छादयत्य् । ऊर्ग् वै मुञ्जा ऊर्जैवैनं प्रश्छादयति । दध्ना संसृजति सतेजस्त्वायाघातुक एनं रुद्रो भवति । हंसवत् करोत्य् । असौ वा आदित्यो हंसा ए ः परिषिञ्च्
3.m: In the middle he places a fan; he thereby makes the navel. Above he places the stool; he thereby makes the chest. He covers it with a black antelope skin. The black antelope skin is the form of the sacred word; he covers it with the sacred word itself. He covers it with muñja grass. Muñja grass is nourishment; he covers it with nourishment itself. He mixes it with curd for the sake of fiery energy, [so that] Rudra does not harm him. He acts like a goose. That sun yonder is the goose. [...] sprinkling around [...] Walking around while sprinkling, [he recites]: ‘You are pleasing, bestowing vigor.’ Thereby he makes its vigor flourish. ‘A child, nourishing the people.’ Thereby he explains its form and greatness. If birds should settle near the Gharma, one should know that these creatures will attend upon him. Therefore he should protect it from birds. With two [verses], ‘Like blood-mouthed cattle dispersing...’, he should offer oblations. Yama is death; with his own share he appeases him. ‘Bring well-being and bring around!’ is the blessing he prays for. With ‘May the waters be friendly to us’, they pour out water; he makes them friendly. With ‘May they be unfriendly to him’, in whichever direction his enemy may be, in that direction he should pour it out; he makes them unfriendly to him. ‘This is your food, O Gharma, this your nourishment.’ Ghee, curd, and honey are his food; he prospers him with that. ‘Thereby increase!’—with proper food he prospers him. ‘And may we increase and swell!’ is the blessing he prays for. ‘You are named Delight.’ That is Rudra’s auspicious name. [...] Thus he prays for this blessing for himself. ‘The drop, the capable falcon, righteous, golden-winged... Follow me to the soma-drinking! You are fuel; may we thrive!’ Thus they buy off Rudra; they do not consign him to grief. ‘You are kindling; may we kindle!’ is the blessing he prays for. ‘Put fiery energy in me again!’—he places fiery energy in himself. With ‘Up this Jātavedas...’, he offers ten oblations.

3.s: pariṣiñcan paryeti valgur asi vayodhāyā iti | vaya evāsyaitad ardhayati |
3.d: परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति वल्गुर् असि वयोधाया इति । वय एवास्यैतद् अर्धयति ।

3.s: śiśur janadhāyā iti | rūpam evāsyaitan mahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | yadi vayāṃsy upāsīran gharmam etāḥ prajā upāsiṣyanta iti vidyāt |
3.d: शिशुर् जनधाया इति । रूपम् एवास्यैतन् महिमानं व्याचष्टे । यदि वयांस्य् उपासीरन् घर्मम् एताः प्रजा उपासिष्यन्त इति विद्यात् ।

3.s: tasmād vayobhyaḥ parirakṣetāsṛṅmukho vi gā iveti dvābhyāṃ juhuyān | mṛtyur vai yamas | svenaivainam bhāgadheyena samayati |
3.d: तस्माद् वयोभ्यः परिरक्षेतासृङ्मुखो वि गा इवेति द्वाभ्यां जुहुयान् । मृत्युर् वै यमस् । स्वेनैवैनम् भागधेयेन समयति ।

3.s: śañ ca vakṣi pari ca vakṣīty āśiṣam evāśāste |
3.d: शञ् च वक्षि परि च वक्षीत्य् आशिषम् एवाशास्ते ।

3.s: sumitrā na āpa ity apa utsiñcanti | sumitrā evaināṃ karoti |
3.d: सुमित्रा न आप इत्य् अप उत्सिञ्चन्ति । सुमित्रा एवैनां करोति ।

3.s: durmitrās tasmai santv iti yasyām asya diśi dveṣyas syāt tān diśam parāsiñced | durmitrā evaināḥ karot | ty |
3.d: दुर्मित्रास् तस्मै सन्त्व् इति यस्याम् अस्य दिशि द्वेष्यस् स्यात् तान् दिशम् परासिञ्चेद् । दुर्मित्रा एवैनाः करोत् । त्य् ।

3.s: etat te gharmānnam etat purīṣam iti | ghṛtaṃ vai dadhi | madhv ity etasyānnan | tenaivainaṃ samardhayati |
3.d: एतत् ते घर्मान्नम् एतत् पुरीषम् इति । घृतं वै दधि । मध्व् इत्य् एतस्यान्नन् । तेनैवैनं समर्धयति ।

3.s: tena tvaṃ vardhasvety annādyenaivainaṃ samardhayati |
3.d: तेन त्वं वर्धस्वेत्य् अन्नाद्येनैवैनं समर्धयति ।

3.s: vardhiṣīmahi ca vayam ā ca pyāyiṣīmahīty āśiṣam evāśāste |
3.d: वर्धिषीमहि च वयम् आ च प्यायिषीमहीत्य् आशिषम् एवाशास्ते ।

3.s: rantir nāmāsīty | etad vai rudrasya śivo nāma | ity | ātmana evaitām āśiṣam āśāsta |
3.d: रन्तिर् नामासीत्य् । एतद् वै रुद्रस्य शिवो नाम । इत्य् । आत्मन एवैताम् आशिषम् आशास्त ।

3.s: indur dakṣaś śyena ṛtāvā hiraṇyapakṣas | somapīthānu mehy edho 'sy edhiṣīmahīti | rudram eva niravadayante | naivainaṃ śucārpayanti |
3.d: इन्दुर् दक्षश् श्येन ऋतावा हिरण्यपक्षस् । सोमपीथानु मेह्य् एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहीति । रुद्रम् एव निरवदयन्ते । नैवैनं शुचार्पयन्ति ।

3.s: samid asi samedhiṣīmahīty āśiṣam evāśāste |
3.d: समिद् असि समेधिषीमहीत्य् आशिषम् एवाशास्ते ।

3.s: punar tejo mayi dhehīti teja evātman dhatta |
3.d: पुनर् तेजो मयि धेहीति तेज एवात्मन् धत्त ।

3.s: ud u tyañ jātavedasam iti daśāhutīr juhoti | daśākṣarā virāḍ annaṃ virāḍ | virājy evānnādye pratitiṣṭhati | kin dīkṣayā spṛṇotīty āhuḥ kim avāntaradīkṣayety | ātmānam eva dīkṣayā spṛṇoti prajām avāntaradīkṣayā | dvādaśa vā eṣa varṣāṇi dīkṣito bhavati yo brahmacārī | tasya vā eṣā dīṣkā yad avāntaradīkṣā | mekhalām ābadhnāte | daṇḍam upayaśchati | samidha āharati | punar adhyāharaty | audumbarīr bhavanty | ūrg vā udumbara | ūrjam eva barhmacāriṇi nidadhāti | parṇamayīr bhavanti | brahmavarcasaṃ vai parṇo | brahmavarcasam eva brahmacāriṇi nidadhāti | śamīmayīr bhavanti | tejo vai śamī | teja eva brahmacāriṇi nidadhāty | agne vratapate pṛthivī samid iti prathamāṃ samidham ādadhāty | agnir vai devānām pṛthivyāyāṃ vratapatis | tasmā eva procya vratañ carati | vratyo bhavati | vāyo vratapate antarikṣas samid iti dvitīyāṃ samidham ādadhāti | vāyur vai devānām antarikṣe vratapatis | tasmā eva procya vratañ carati | vratyo bhavati |
3.d: उद् उ त्यञ् जातवेदसम् इति दशाहुतीर् जुहोति । दशाक्षरा विराड् अन्नं विराड् । विराज्य् एवान्नाद्ये प्रतितिष्ठति । किन् दीक्षया स्पृणोतीत्य् आहुः किम् अवान्तरदीक्षयेत्य् । आत्मानम् एव दीक्षया स्पृणोति प्रजाम् अवान्तरदीक्षया । द्वादश वा एष वर्षाणि दीक्षितो भवति यो ब्रह्मचारी । तस्य वा एषा दीष्का यद् अवान्तरदीक्षा । मेखलाम् आबध्नाते । दण्डम् उपयश्छति । समिध आहरति । पुनर् अध्याहरत्य् । औदुम्बरीर् भवन्त्य् । ऊर्ग् वा उदुम्बर । ऊर्जम् एव बर्ह्मचारिणि निदधाति । पर्णमयीर् भवन्ति । ब्रह्मवर्चसं वै पर्णो । ब्रह्मवर्चसम् एव ब्रह्मचारिणि निदधाति । शमीमयीर् भवन्ति । तेजो वै शमी । तेज एव ब्रह्मचारिणि निदधात्य् । अग्ने व्रतपते पृथिवी समिद् इति प्रथमां समिधम् आदधात्य् । अग्निर् वै देवानाम् पृथिव्यायां व्रतपतिस् । तस्मा एव प्रोच्य व्रतञ् चरति । व्रत्यो भवति । वायो व्रतपते अन्तरिक्षस् समिद् इति द्वितीयां समिधम् आदधाति । वायुर् वै देवानाम् अन्तरिक्षे व्रतपतिस् । तस्मा एव प्रोच्य व्रतञ् चरति । व्रत्यो भवति ।
3.m: The Virāj consists of ten syllables; the Virāj is food. Verily he is established in the Virāj, in proper food. They say: 'What does he save through the consecration? What through the intermediate consecration?' Verily he saves himself through the consecration, and offspring through the intermediate consecration. For twelve years indeed is he consecrated who is a Vedic student. This intermediate consecration is indeed his consecration. He fastens the girdle. He takes up the staff. He fetches kindling sticks. He brings [them] over again. They are of udumbara wood. Nourishment, indeed, is the udumbara. Verily he places nourishment in the Vedic student. They are of palāśa wood. Priestly splendor, indeed, is the palāśa. Verily he places priestly splendor in the Vedic student. They are of śamī wood. Fiery energy, indeed, is the śamī. Verily he places fiery energy in the Vedic student. 'O Agni, lord of vows, the earth is the kindling stick,' saying this he puts on the first kindling stick. Agni indeed among the gods is the lord of vows on the earth. Having declared it to him, he performs the vow; he becomes fit for vows. 'O Vāyu, lord of vows, the atmosphere is the kindling stick,' saying this he puts on the second kindling stick. Vāyu indeed among the gods is the lord of vows in the atmosphere. Having declared it to him, he performs the vow; he becomes fit for vows. 'O Sūrya, lord of vows, heaven is the kindling stick,' saying this he puts on the third kindling stick. Sūrya indeed among the gods is the lord of vows in yonder world. Having declared it to him, he performs the vow; he becomes fit for vows. He does not converse, nor does he look at [anyone]; he places fiery energy in himself. He should stand at the joint of the day; he should sit at night for fiery energy; he eats what is cooked by Agni and the sun. Verily the consecrated is the oblation; he eats only the oblation. When it is completed, he recites. Verily he who is a Vedic student falls away from the other worlds. When he puts on the kindling sticks upwards from here, he is thereby established in yonder world. When he puts them on backwards hither from there, he is thereby established in this world. When the garmut grass sprouts, then he should recite. When the deer eats barley, then he should recite. When the boar eats the lotus root, then he should recite.

3.s: sūrya vratapate dyaus samid iti tṛtīyāṃ samidham ādadhāti | sūryo vai devānām amuṣmiṃ lloke vratapatis | tasmā eva procya vratañ carati | vratyo bhavati | nābhivyāharati nābhiprekṣate | teja evātman dhatte | parvaṇi tiṣṭhed divā āsīta naktaṃ satejastvāyāgninādityena ca śrītam aśnāti | havir vai dīkṣito | havir evātti | samāpte 'nvāha | pra vā itarebhyo lokebhyaś cyavate yo brahmacārī | yad ita ūrdhvaṃ samidha ādadhāty amuṣmiṃs tena loke pratitiṣṭhati | yad amuto 'rvāṅ pratyādadhāty asmiṃs tena loke pratitiṣṭhati | yadā garmuto virohati tadānubrūyād | dhariṇo yadā yavam atti tadānubrūyāt | sūkaro yadā bisam atti tadānubrūyād | rūpasamṛddhim evānvāha | tejasā vā eṣa prajayā paśubhir brahmavarcasenānnādyena ca vyṛddhyate yo brahmacārī | yan nābhivyāharati nābhiprekṣate tejo evātman dhatte | yat kanyām abhivyāharaty abhiprekṣate prajām evātman dhatte | yad vatsam abhivyāharaty abhiprekṣate paśūn evātman dhatte | yadādityam abhivyāharaty abhiprekṣate brahmavarcasam evātman dhatte | yat kṣīraudanam abhivyāharaty abhiprekṣate 'nnādyam evātman dhatte | 'tho tejasvī prajāvān paśumān brahmavarcasy anūradho bhavati ya evaṃ veda | āyurdā āyur me dehīty āyur evātman dadhate | pravṛjyamān upadhāya mārjayaty | a tādevāvyādhi |
3.d: सूर्य व्रतपते द्यौस् समिद् इति तृतीयां समिधम् आदधाति । सूर्यो वै देवानाम् अमुष्मिं ल्लोके व्रतपतिस् । तस्मा एव प्रोच्य व्रतञ् चरति । व्रत्यो भवति । नाभिव्याहरति नाभिप्रेक्षते । तेज एवात्मन् धत्ते । पर्वणि तिष्ठेद् दिवा आसीत नक्तं सतेजस्त्वायाग्निनादित्येन च श्रीतम् अश्नाति । हविर् वै दीक्षितो । हविर् एवात्ति । समाप्ते ऽन्वाह । प्र वा इतरेभ्यो लोकेभ्यश् च्यवते यो ब्रह्मचारी । यद् इत ऊर्ध्वं समिध आदधात्य् अमुष्मिंस् तेन लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । यद् अमुतो ऽर्वाङ् प्रत्यादधात्य् अस्मिंस् तेन लोके प्रतितिष्ठति । यदा गर्मुतो विरोहति तदानुब्रूयाद् । धरिणो यदा यवम् अत्ति तदानुब्रूयात् । सूकरो यदा बिसम् अत्ति तदानुब्रूयाद् । रूपसमृद्धिम् एवान्वाह । तेजसा वा एष प्रजया पशुभिर् ब्रह्मवर्चसेनान्नाद्येन च व्यृद्ध्यते यो ब्रह्मचारी । यन् नाभिव्याहरति नाभिप्रेक्षते तेजो एवात्मन् धत्ते । यत् कन्याम् अभिव्याहरत्य् अभिप्रेक्षते प्रजाम् एवात्मन् धत्ते । यद् वत्सम् अभिव्याहरत्य् अभिप्रेक्षते पशून् एवात्मन् धत्ते । यदादित्यम् अभिव्याहरत्य् अभिप्रेक्षते ब्रह्मवर्चसम् एवात्मन् धत्ते । यत् क्षीरौदनम् अभिव्याहरत्य् अभिप्रेक्षते ऽन्नाद्यम् एवात्मन् धत्ते । ऽथो तेजस्वी प्रजावान् पशुमान् ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अनूरधो भवति य एवं वेद । आयुर्दा आयुर् मे देहीत्य् आयुर् एवात्मन् दधते । प्रवृज्यमान् उपधाय मार्जयत्य् । अ तादेवाव्याधि ।
3.m: Verily he recites the fullness of form. Verily he who is a Vedic student is deprived of fiery energy, of offspring, of cattle, of priestly splendor, and of proper food. In that he does not converse nor look at [anyone], he places fiery energy in himself. In that he converses with and looks at a maiden, he places offspring in himself. In that he converses with and looks at a calf, he places cattle in himself. In that he converses with and looks at the sun, he places priestly splendor in himself. In that he converses with and looks at milk-rice, he places proper food in himself. Moreover, endowed with fiery energy, rich in offspring, rich in cattle, endowed with priestly splendor, and prosperous becomes he who knows thus. 'O giver of life, give me life,' saying this they place life in themselves. [...] while being placed on the fire [...] having placed, he cleanses [...] free from disease. 'O givers of prāṇa, give me prāṇa,' saying this they place prāṇa in themselves. 'O giver of vyāna, give me vyāna,' saying this they place vyāna in themselves. 'O giver of apāna, give me apāna,' saying this they place apāna in themselves. 'O giver of sight, give me sight,' saying this they place sight in themselves. 'O giver of hearing, give me hearing,' saying this they place hearing in themselves. 'O giver of splendor, give me splendor,' saying this they place splendor in themselves. 'Give back to us for life,' saying this they place life in themselves. Moreover, for non-loosening, for non-burning [he says]: 'Homage to Rudra.' The gods indeed excluded Rudra from the sacrifice. He stood leaning on his bow. Indra, in the form of an ant, cut his bowstring. It made the sound 'ghṛṅ'. Its recoil crushed his head. That became the Pravargya. Because the deities are great and valorous, therefore [it is called] Mahāvīra. Because the bow made the sound 'ghṛṅ', therefore [it is called] Gharma. Because it is placed on the fire, therefore [it is called] Pravargya. Therefore, he who sacrifices with a sacrifice accompanied by the Pravargya restores the head of Rudra. Rudra does not become harmful to him who knows thus. [...] These are the bright rites of the bright ones. That is the brightness of the bright ones. With them the gods performed the Pravargya in front of the sacrifice.

3.s: 'tho 'visraṃsāyaivāpradāhāya namo rudrāyeti | rudraṃ vai devā yajñān nirabhajan | sa dhanur avaṣṭabhyātiṣṭhat | tasyendro vamrirūpeṇa dhanurjyām aśchinat | sa ghṛṅṅ akarot | tasyārtiś śira utpipeṣa | sa pravargyo 'bhavad | yan mahatīr devatā vīryavatīs tasmān mahāvīro | yad dhanur ghṛṅṅ akarot tasmād gharmo | yat pravṛjyate tasmāt pravargyas | tasmād yas sapravargyeṇa yajñena yajate rudrasya śira upadadhāti | nainaṃ rudra āruko bhavati ya evaṃ veda | śukriyāṇāṃ vā etāni śukriyāṇi | tac chukriyāṇāṃ śukriyatvaṃ | tebhir devāḥ purastād yajñasya prāvṛñjata | yat prāvṛñjata tasmāt pravargyāṇi tasmāt pravargyas | tasmād yas sapravargyeṇa yajñena yajate mukhyo brahmavarcasī bhavaty | eṣa vāva tarhi yajña āsīd yad eṣa jyotiṣṭomas | tad yathā vā idam agner jātād agnayo 'nye vihriyanta evam asmād anye yajñakratavaḥ prajāyante | tasmāj jyotiṣṭome pravṛñjyād yajñasyordhvatvāya | nokthye pravṛñjyāt | prajā vai paśava ukthāni | yad ukthye pravṛñjyāt prajāñ cāsya paśūṃś ca nirdahet | tasmāt prajākāmāya paśukāmāya na pravṛñjyād | asau vā ādityo rudro mahāvīro | rudrād eva prajām paśūn parivṛṇakti | tasmād vāsasā patnīm praśchādayati prajāyā apradāhāya | sarvatopakrame pravṛñjyād |
3.d: ऽथो ऽविस्रंसायैवाप्रदाहाय नमो रुद्रायेति । रुद्रं वै देवा यज्ञान् निरभजन् । स धनुर् अवष्टभ्यातिष्ठत् । तस्येन्द्रो वम्रिरूपेण धनुर्ज्याम् अश्छिनत् । स घृङ्ङ् अकरोत् । तस्यार्तिश् शिर उत्पिपेष । स प्रवर्ग्यो ऽभवद् । यन् महतीर् देवता वीर्यवतीस् तस्मान् महावीरो । यद् धनुर् घृङ्ङ् अकरोत् तस्माद् घर्मो । यत् प्रवृज्यते तस्मात् प्रवर्ग्यस् । तस्माद् यस् सप्रवर्ग्येण यज्ञेन यजते रुद्रस्य शिर उपदधाति । नैनं रुद्र आरुको भवति य एवं वेद । शुक्रियाणां वा एतानि शुक्रियाणि । तच् छुक्रियाणां शुक्रियत्वं । तेभिर् देवाः पुरस्ताद् यज्ञस्य प्रावृञ्जत । यत् प्रावृञ्जत तस्मात् प्रवर्ग्याणि तस्मात् प्रवर्ग्यस् । तस्माद् यस् सप्रवर्ग्येण यज्ञेन यजते मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवत्य् । एष वाव तर्हि यज्ञ आसीद् यद् एष ज्योतिष्टोमस् । तद् यथा वा इदम् अग्नेर् जाताद् अग्नयो ऽन्ये विह्रियन्त एवम् अस्माद् अन्ये यज्ञक्रतवः प्रजायन्ते । तस्माज् ज्योतिष्टोमे प्रवृञ्ज्याद् यज्ञस्योर्ध्वत्वाय । नोक्थ्ये प्रवृञ्ज्यात् । प्रजा वै पशव उक्थानि । यद् उक्थ्ये प्रवृञ्ज्यात् प्रजाञ् चास्य पशूंश् च निर्दहेत् । तस्मात् प्रजाकामाय पशुकामाय न प्रवृञ्ज्याद् । असौ वा आदित्यो रुद्रो महावीरो । रुद्राद् एव प्रजाम् पशून् परिवृणक्ति । तस्माद् वाससा पत्नीम् प्रश्छादयति प्रजाया अप्रदाहाय । सर्वतोपक्रमे प्रवृञ्ज्याद् ।
3.m: Because they performed the Pravargya, therefore they are Pravargyas, therefore it is the Pravargya. Therefore he who sacrifices with a sacrifice accompanied by the Pravargya becomes prominent and endowed with priestly splendor. That indeed was the sacrifice then, which is this Jyotiṣṭoma. Just as indeed other fires are carried out from this produced fire, so other sacrifice-rituals are produced from this. Therefore he should perform the Pravargya in the Jyotiṣṭoma for the elevation of the sacrifice. He should not perform the Pravargya in the Ukthya. Offspring and cattle, indeed, are the ukthas. If he should perform the Pravargya in the Ukthya, he would burn up his offspring and cattle. Therefore he should not perform the Pravargya for one who desires offspring or for one who desires cattle. Yonder sun indeed is Rudra, the Mahāvīra. Rudra surely excludes offspring and cattle. Therefore he covers the wife with a cloth to prevent burning of offspring. He should perform the Pravargya at the commencement of everything. 'Bhūr bhuvas svar.' 'Homage to speech, homage to the lord of speech.' Sarasvatī, indeed, is speech. 'Whichever speech is uttered and whichever is unuttered, to that speech be homage.' [...] 'Homage to the ṛṣis, makers of mantras, knowers of mantras.' [...] 'May the ṛṣis, makers of mantras, knowers of mantras, not abandon me.' [...] 'May I speak divine speech,' thus he speaks only divine speech. 'Auspicious, unexhausted,' thus he makes it auspicious and unexhausted. 'Pleasing to the gods,' thus he makes it pleasing to the gods. 'Accompanied by the svadhā call for the ancestors,' thus he makes it accompanied by the svadhā call for the ancestors. 'Worthy of being heard by men,' thus he makes it worthy of being heard by men. 'May the gods aid me for beauty, may the ancestors approve,' saying this the gods aid him, the ancestors approve him for beauty. 'May I be good of sight with my eyes, of good splendor with my face, good of hearing with my ears,' as according to the yajus. At the completion also they cleanse themselves: 'Be auspicious, most beneficent, very gracious to us, O Sarasvatī.' Sarasvatī, indeed, is speech.

3.s: bhūr bhuvas svar | namo vāce namo vācaspataya iti | vāg vai sarasvatī | yā vāg uditā yā cānuditā tasyai vāce nama iti | nama ṛṣibhyo mantrakṛdbhyo mantravidbhya iti | mā mām ṛṣayo mantrakṛto mantravidaḥ parādur iti | daivīṃ vācam udyāsam iti daivīm eva vācaṃ vadati |

3.s: śivā naś śantamā bhava sumṛḷīkā sarasvatīti | vāg vai sarasvatī | vācaiva prayanti vācodyanti |
3.d: शिवा नश् शन्तमा भव सुमृऌईका सरस्वतीति । वाग् वै सरस्वती । वाचैव प्रयन्ति वाचोद्यन्ति ।
3.m: With speech they set forth; with speech they arise. [With the mantra:] 'You are the under-spreading of the brahman priest; for the brahman priest I spread you under,' he makes an under-spreading for offspring and cattle. [With the mantra:] 'You are the home of Īḻā,' for firm standing. [With the mantra:] 'Wind, blow medicine; wind, blow away whatever evil there is': breath indeed is Vāyu; it is breath that he makes most abundant for him. [With the mantra:] 'Waters, you are blissful' […]. The ṛc-verses, the yajus-formulas, the sāmans: thus the Veda is threefold arranged. […] threefold is arranged for him the acquisition and preservation of offspring, cattle, and subjects. Now he, when about to observe the vow, having gone out into the wilderness to a pure spot of earth where the village roof is out of sight, teaches [it]. A pen of death indeed is the village, while that of the gods is the wilderness. He wins beyond repeated death who knows this. When the sun has risen, in the forenoon, in the bright half of the month, during the northern course [of the sun], he should study. This indeed is the tri-śukriya. Tri-śukriya becomes he who knows this. Not under clouds, not in dense haze, not among cattle, not on the new- or full-moon day nor during the intermediate nodes, for the non-injury of himself. Not facing a dead two-footed or four-footed creature, for the non-injury of himself. Not having seen a dead two-footed or four-footed creature, flesh, bone, blood, a Caṇḍāla, or an impure thing; for these are unholy, [it is] for holiness. Not having eaten meat on the previous day. Not having engaged in unchaste behavior on the previous day. On that day in the forenoon he should not have his hair, beard, body-hair, or nails shaved, nor scrape himself, nor anoint [his eyes], nor smear himself [with oil], nor bathe, for the non-loss of his fiery energy. Unpacified, he should not come into contact with the sight of domestic animals. […] he should have vessels made. Consecration is ascetic heat; by ascetic heat he harnesses for him. He stands to the north. At it he harnesses the chief Mahāvīra, day after day the other two. The first of them is connected with the Gāyatrī, the second with the Triṣṭubh, the third with the Jagatī. Day after day according to the original order he harnesses the meters. The head of the sacrifice, indeed, is the Pravargya.

3.s: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti | ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmānīti | tad vai tredhāvihito yad vedaḥ | kalpate 'smai tredhā yogakṣemaḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ viśaḥ | athaiṣa vrataṃ cariṣyann araṇyam paretya śucau bhūmyavakāśe grāmādaśchadirdarśe 'dhyāpayati | mṛtyor vā eṣa goṣṭho yad grāmo | 'thaiṣa devānāṃ yad araṇyam | apa punarmṛtyuṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda udita āditye pūrvāhṇe pūrvapakṣa udagayane 'dhīyītaitad vai triśukriyaṃ | triśukriyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda | nābhreṣu na samauhe na gavām ante na parvopaparvayor ātmano 'hiṃsāyai | na mṛtaṃ dvipadāñ catuṣpadām praty ātmano 'hiṃsāyai | na mṛtaṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ māṃsam asthi lohitaṃ caṇḍālam aśuci vā dṛṣṭvāmedhyāni vā etāni medhyatvāya | na pūrvedyur māṃsam attvā | na pūrvedyur abrahmacaryam upetya | na tad ahaḥ pūrvāhṇe keśaśmaśrū lomanakhāni vāpayen nāvalikhen nāñjyān nābhyañjyān na snāyāt tejaso 'navabhraṃśāya | na grāmyāṇām paśūnāṃ sandarśanenāśāntikṛtas saṃsṛjeta | pātrāṇi kārayet | tapo vai dīkṣā | tapasaivāsya prayunakty | uttaratas tiṣṭhati | tasmin mukhyaṃ mahāvīraṃ prajunakty anvaham itarau | gāyatro vā eteṣām prathamas traiṣṭubho dvitīyo jāgatas tṛtīyo | 'nvaham eva yathāpūrvaṃ chandāṃsi yunakti | śiro vā etad yajñasya yat pravargyas | tasya kapālāni kapālāni keśā vedau dhavitre karṇau dhavitradaṇḍau nāsike rukmau cakṣuṣī | sauvarṇo dakṣiṇaṃ rājata uttaraṃ mahāvīrāḥ kaṇṭhā āsyañ caruṣṭhālī hanū śaphā aniṣṭubdhī aṣṭhīvantau daṃṣṭrā mayūkhā dantā yad gharme nidadhāti jihvāpayāmo rajjvoś ca vaiṇavāni snāvāni puroḷāśo mastiṣko | yad aṅgārair abhyūhati tan māṃsaṃ keśā vedā ājyaṃ majjā payasī meda | ṛco rūpaṃ yajūṃṣi prāṇās sāmāni jyotīṃṣi diśaś śrotram | ete ca vai yajñaś śīrṣaṇvāṃś | chīrṣaṇyo mukhyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda etad vā etac chiro | nāsmād u āhus te bhaga cakṣuṣī tābhyāṃ vipaśya mām abhīti | tasya sūryacandramāsāv eva cakṣuṣī |
3.d: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुव इति । ऋचो यजूंषि सामानीति । तद् वै त्रेधाविहितो यद् वेदः । कल्पते ऽस्मै त्रेधा योगक्षेमः प्रजायाः पशूनां विशः । अथैष व्रतं चरिष्यन्न् अरण्यम् परेत्य शुचौ भूम्यवकाशे ग्रामादश्छदिर्दर्शे ऽध्यापयति । मृत्योर् वा एष गोष्ठो यद् ग्रामो । ऽथैष देवानां यद् अरण्यम् । अप पुनर्मृत्युं जयति य एवं वेद उदित आदित्ये पूर्वाह्णे पूर्वपक्ष उदगयने ऽधीयीतैतद् वै त्रिशुक्रियं । त्रिशुक्रियो भवति य एवं वेद । नाभ्रेषु न समौहे न गवाम् अन्ते न पर्वोपपर्वयोर् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै । न मृतं द्विपदाञ् चतुष्पदाम् प्रत्य् आत्मनो ऽहिंसायै । न मृतं द्विपदां चतुष्पदां मांसम् अस्थि लोहितं चण्डालम् अशुचि वा दृष्ट्वामेध्यानि वा एतानि मेध्यत्वाय । न पूर्वेद्युर् मांसम् अत्त्वा । न पूर्वेद्युर् अब्रह्मचर्यम् उपेत्य । न तद् अहः पूर्वाह्णे केशश्मश्रू लोमनखानि वापयेन् नावलिखेन् नाञ्ज्यान् नाभ्यञ्ज्यान् न स्नायात् तेजसो ऽनवभ्रंशाय । न ग्राम्याणाम् पशूनां सन्दर्शनेनाशान्तिकृतस् संसृजेत । पात्राणि कारयेत् । तपो वै दीक्षा । तपसैवास्य प्रयुनक्त्य् । उत्तरतस् तिष्ठति । तस्मिन् मुख्यं महावीरं प्रजुनक्त्य् अन्वहम् इतरौ । गायत्रो वा एतेषाम् प्रथमस् त्रैष्टुभो द्वितीयो जागतस् तृतीयो । ऽन्वहम् एव यथापूर्वं छन्दांसि युनक्ति । शिरो वा एतद् यज्ञस्य यत् प्रवर्ग्यस् । तस्य कपालानि कपालानि केशा वेदौ धवित्रे कर्णौ धवित्रदण्डौ नासिके रुक्मौ चक्षुषी । सौवर्णो दक्षिणं राजत उत्तरं महावीराः कण्ठा आस्यञ् चरुष्ठाली हनू शफा अनिष्टुब्धी अष्ठीवन्तौ दंष्ट्रा मयूखा दन्ता यद् घर्मे निदधाति जिह्वापयामो रज्ज्वोश् च वैणवानि स्नावानि पुरोऌआशो मस्तिष्को । यद् अङ्गारैर् अभ्यूहति तन् मांसं केशा वेदा आज्यं मज्जा पयसी मेद । ऋचो रूपं यजूंषि प्राणास् सामानि ज्योतींषि दिशश् श्रोत्रम् । एते च वै यज्ञश् शीर्षण्वांश् । छीर्षण्यो मुख्यो भवति य एवं वेद एतद् वा एतच् छिरो । नास्माद् उ आहुस् ते भग चक्षुषी ताभ्यां विपश्य माम् अभीति । तस्य सूर्यचन्द्रमासाव् एव चक्षुषी ।
3.m: Its potsherds are the skull-bones; its hair is the two grass-brooms; the two fanning-fans are the ears; the two fan-handles are the nostrils; the two gold plates are the eyes—the golden one the right, the silver one the left. The Mahāvīras are the neck; the caru-pot is the mouth; the two hooves are the jaws; the two aniṣṭubdhis are the knee-caps; the tusks are the pegs; the teeth are what he deposits in the Gharma; the bamboo cord-holders of the two ropes are the tongue; the sinews are the bamboo cords; the puroḍāśa is the brain. That he covers it over with live coals, that is the flesh; the hair is the grass-brooms; the clarified butter is marrow; the two milks are fat. The ṛc-verses are the form; the yajus-formulas are the breaths; the sāmans are the lights; the quarters of space are the hearing. And these are the sacrifice possessing a head. Endowed with a head, chief does he become who knows this. This indeed is that head; not from him […]. [With the mantra:] 'They call you Bhaga, the two eyes; with those look upon me' […]; of it, the sun and moon are indeed the two eyes. […] [With the mantra:] 'With that wild-honey-essence I anoint your form; with that anoint my form': thus he proclaims its form and majesty. [With the mantra:] 'With the rituals of the gods, with the divine unguents I anoint [you]; you are the one having the name Lord': this indeed is Rudra's dear name; with his dear name, with divine unguents, he anoints him. [With the mantra:] 'Of him, yours are the ṛc-verses, the yajus-formulas, and the sāmans': 'the ṛc-verses, the yajus-formulas, and the sāmans,' he means by this. [With the mantra:] 'Speech in Agni, one eye in the sun, one in the sun, one in Agni, one in Agni, one in Agni': thus he invigorates his two eyes. For Bhaga is blind. Blind offspring are not born to him. [With the mantra:] 'May I become endowed with fortune': he places sight in himself. [With the mantra:] 'You are Ira's descendant; you are sight; you are hearing; you are the speech named Purandhi': he instructs them. Therefore instructed offspring are born. [With the mantra:] 'With that which Śatakratu offered the share, with that I invoke you, Bhaga': the gods indeed excluded Rudra from a share; he turned toward the gods with stretched [bow]; those gods invoked him with this dear name, with this dear abode, which is the Pravargya.

3.s: yad etat sāragham madhu tena rūpam anajmi te tena rūpam anagdhi ma iti rūpam evāsyaitan mahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | devānāṃ kratubhir devābhyañjanair abhyañje bhagavan nāmāsīty | etad vai rudrasya priyaṃ nāmadheyam | priyeṇaivainaṃ nāmadheyena devābhyañjanais samanakti |

3.d: येन शतक्रतुर् भागम् उपजुह्वे तेन त्वोपह्वये भगेति । रुद्रं वै देवा निरभजन् । स देवान् आयतयाभिपर्यावर्तत । ते देवा एतेन नामधेयेन प्रियेण धाम्नोपह्वयन् यत् प्रवर्ग्यस् । स्वेनैवैनं नामधेयेन प्रियेण धामनोपह्वयते ।
3.m: With his own dear name, with his dear abode he invokes him. [With the mantra:] 'O men, that fierce wonder of yours I reveal for gain, as thunder [reveals] rain, when Dadhyañc Ātharvaṇa spoke the favor of honey to you with the head of a horse. Agni rules over wealth, Agni over great good fortune; may they bestow those upon us' […]. Rudra indeed is Agni. He is possessing wealth, good fortune […]. The gods and the Asuras did the same at the Pravargya. Whatever the gods did, that the Asuras did. Those gods saw these viewing-mantras. With them, when the Gharma had shone bright at this sacrifice, they looked. The gods prospered; the Asuras were defeated. When one looks upon the Pravargya with these viewing-mantras, he becomes possessing offspring, possessing cattle, possessing sweetness. [With the mantra:] 'Ten to the east, ten to the south you shine,' for the obtaining of the quarters of space. Who indeed knows how great these worlds are? All the worlds indeed he obtains with these viewing-mantras. [With the mantra:] 'Ten to the east, ten to the south you shine, ten to the west, ten to the north you shine, ten upward you shine, being well-disposed': light indeed is brilliance; it is brilliance that he invigorates for him. [With the mantra:] 'Being unwrathful, protect our offspring and cattle,' for the safeguarding of offspring and cattle. Possessing offspring and possessing cattle he becomes who knows this, who knows the Pravargya-Upaniṣad. The gods indeed were afraid of the Mahāvīra when it had shone bright, thinking: 'This one will burn us all up with fiery energy.' They ran to Prajāpati. That Prajāpati said: 'Wait upon him with another; he will become auspicious.' […] [With the words:] 'Bhūr bhuvas svar' […] 'Bhuvas has been placed' […] [With the words:] 'Nṛmṇāyi nṛmṇam': offspring indeed are wealth, cattle are wealth; he buys off this Rudra from offspring and from cattle. 'Nidhāyyovā, nidhāyyovā'—with the sāman he sings as Udgātṛ. Thereby he stands firmly in a foundation. 'E svarjyotī3r': that sun yonder is this light. Thereby he causes him to prosper. These indeed are his dear bodies.

3.s: tad vāṃ narā sanaye daṃsa ugram āviṣkṛṇomi tanyatur na vṛṣṭiṃ | dadhyaṅ ha yan madhv ātharvaṇo vām aśvasya śīrṣṇā sumatim avocat | agnir īśe vāsavayasyāgnir mahas saubhagasya tāny asmabhyaṃ rāsata iti | agnir vai rudras | sa vāsavyas saubhaga devāś ca vā asurāś ca samāvad eva pravargye 'kurvata | yad eva devā akurvata tad asurā akurvata | te devā etān avakāśān apaśyams | tair etasmin yajñe gharme rucite 'vaikṣata | te devā abhavan parāsurā abhavan | yat pravargyam etair avakāśair avekṣate bhavati prajāvān paśumān madhavyo bhavati |
3.d: तद् वां नरा सनये दंस उग्रम् आविष्कृणोमि तन्यतुर् न वृष्टिं । दध्यङ् ह यन् मध्व् आथर्वणो वाम् अश्वस्य शीर्ष्णा सुमतिम् अवोचत् । अग्निर् ईशे वासवयस्याग्निर् महस् सौभगस्य तान्य् अस्मभ्यं रासत इति । अग्निर् वै रुद्रस् । स वासव्यस् सौभग देवाश् च वा असुराश् च समावद् एव प्रवर्ग्ये ऽकुर्वत । यद् एव देवा अकुर्वत तद् असुरा अकुर्वत । ते देवा एतान् अवकाशान् अपश्यम्स् । तैर् एतस्मिन् यज्ञे घर्मे रुचिते ऽवैक्षत । ते देवा अभवन् परासुरा अभवन् । यत् प्रवर्ग्यम् एतैर् अवकाशैर् अवेक्षते भवति प्रजावान् पशुमान् मधव्यो भवति ।

3.s: daśa prācīr daśa bhāsi dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīr daśa bhāsy udīcīr daśordhvā bhāsi sumanasyamāna iti | tejo vai bhās | teja evasyaitad uddharṣayati |

3.s: sa naḥ prajāṃ paśūn pāhy ahṛṇiyamāna iti prajāyāḥ paśūnāṅ gopīthāya | prajāvān paśumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda yaḥ pravargyopaniṣadaṃ veda | devā vai mahāvīrād rucitād abibhayus sarvān no 'yan tejasoddhakṣyatīti | te prajāpatim upādhāvan | sa prajāpatir abravīd anyenainam upatiṣṭhata śivo bhaviṣyatīti | bhūr bhuvas svar iti | bhuvo 'dhāyīti | nṛmṇāyi nṛmṇam iti prajā vai nṛmṇā paśavo nṛmṇam | prajābhyaś caivainam etat paśubhyaś ca rudraṃ niravadayate |
3.d: स नः प्रजां पशून् पाह्य् अहृणियमान इति प्रजायाः पशूनाङ् गोपीथाय । प्रजावान् पशुमान् भवति य एवं वेद यः प्रवर्ग्योपनिषदं वेद । देवा वै महावीराद् रुचिताद् अबिभयुस् सर्वान् नो ऽयन् तेजसोद्धक्ष्यतीति । ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावन् । स प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीद् अन्येनैनम् उपतिष्ठत शिवो भविष्यतीति । भूर् भुवस् स्वर् इति । भुवो ऽधायीति । नृम्णायि नृम्णम् इति प्रजा वै नृम्णा पशवो नृम्णम् । प्रजाभ्यश् चैवैनम् एतत् पशुभ्यश् च रुद्रं निरवदयते ।

3.s: nidhāyy ovā nidhāyy oveti vai sāmnodgāyati | tenaiva nidhau pratitiṣṭhata |

3.s: e svar jyotī3r ity | asau vā āditya etaj jyotis | tenaivanaṃ samrdhayaty | eta vā etasya priyās tanvas | tābhir evainaṃ samardhayaty | etā vā etasyāniruktās stutayas | tābhir evainam abhiṣṭuvanty | etā vā etasyāni ruktās stutayo yad svar jyotis | tābhir evainam abhivyāharanty | etāni vā etasyāniruktāni nāmadheyāni bhuvo nṛmṇo nidhis svar jyotis | tam eva pratyakṣam ṛdhnuvanty | ayaṃ vai loko gārhapatyo 'sā āhavanīyo | yanti vā ete 'smāḷ lokād | ya etaṃ gārhapatye haviṣṭṛtya prāñcam uddhṛtyaitenāhavanīye caranti | ta etam punas saṃsthāpya pracaratni |
3.d: ए स्वर् ज्योती3र् इत्य् । असौ वा आदित्य एतज् ज्योतिस् । तेनैवनं सम्र्धयत्य् । एत वा एतस्य प्रियास् तन्वस् । ताभिर् एवैनं समर्धयत्य् । एता वा एतस्यानिरुक्तास् स्तुतयस् । ताभिर् एवैनम् अभिष्टुवन्त्य् । एता वा एतस्यानि रुक्तास् स्तुतयो यद् स्वर् ज्योतिस् । ताभिर् एवैनम् अभिव्याहरन्त्य् । एतानि वा एतस्यानिरुक्तानि नामधेयानि भुवो नृम्णो निधिस् स्वर् ज्योतिस् । तम् एव प्रत्यक्षम् ऋध्नुवन्त्य् । अयं वै लोको गार्हपत्यो ऽसा आहवनीयो । यन्ति वा एते ऽस्माऌ लोकाद् । य एतं गार्हपत्ये हविष्टृत्य प्राञ्चम् उद्धृत्यैतेनाहवनीये चरन्ति । त एतम् पुनस् संस्थाप्य प्रचरत्नि ।
3.m: With these very [verses] he makes him prosper. These are indeed his unexpressed praises; with them they praise him. These are indeed his unexpressed praises: 'the light of heaven'. With them they address him. These are indeed his unexpressed names: 'the earthly realm, valor, treasure, the light of heaven'. Thus they make him prosper directly. This world is indeed the Gārhapatya, that [heavenly world] is the Āhavanīya. They depart indeed from this world who, having prepared the oblation in the Gārhapatya [and] having carried it eastwards, proceed with it in the Āhavanīya. Having completed it again, they proceed. With 'You, O Agni, lord of the house…', he attends upon the Gārhapatya. He firmly establishes himself in this very world. […] This indeed is the womb of the waters, for having the same origin. For whomever he desires, 'May I be endowed with fiery energy, may I be endowed with priestly splendor', having removed it for him at the midday pressing, he should proceed with the Pravargya. The Pravargya is indeed fiery energy and priestly splendor; he obtains fiery energy and priestly splendor. If he should employ it, with 'You belong to the Anuṣṭubh', he should make a fourth lump. The Anuṣṭubh is speech; he joins speech at the mouth of the sacrifice. He should have the vessels made in two sets. They should stand until the pressing, so that they do not lose their freshness. He should place [the Mahāvīra] on the fire in the fire-kindler's shed; it should shine in the fire-kindler's shed; it should be set upon [the fire] in the fire-kindler's shed. For at this time his abode is the fire-kindler's shed; thus he places splendor in his own abode. He offers on the high altar fire; the high altar fire is the heavenly world, for the attainment of the heavenly world. In this very [fire], before the purificatory bath, he heaps up the vessels. To the south he pushes near the Āhavanīya fire; he heaps up the vessels. To the west he scatters near the Āhavanīya fire; he conceals the vessels, or they should carry them to an island. That sun is Rudra, the Mahāvīra. He becomes endowed with fiery energy and priestly splendor among men.

3.s: tvam agne gṛhapata iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate | 'sminneva loke pratitiṣṭhati | nta | eṣa vā apāṃ yonis sayonitvāya | yaṅ kāmayate tejasvī bhūyāsam brahmavarcasī bhūyāsam iti tasyaitam uduhya mādhyandine savane pravargyeṇa careta | tejo vai brahmavarcasam pravargyas | teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe |

bhavatas | te puroḷāśayor gāyati | cakṣuṣī vā ete pravargyasya yat sūryācandramasau cakṣuṣī rāḥanarauhiṇe | cakṣuṣor eva cakṣur dadhāty | āṅgirasam bhavati | tat parigharmya āropyamāṇe gāyaty |
